title: Marketing Automation, Copywriting & CRO Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a growing parenting education company that helps parents of young children move from reactive parenting to clear, repeatable systems that build cooperation, responsibility, emotional security, and self-governance. Our founder is a nationally recognized parenting expert, and our content reaches a large and engaged audience of parents across social media.



Behind that content is a growing set of systems that turn interest into relationships. Social channels feed ManyChat conversations, which feed our CRM,
, checkout, and customer records. Those connections are what allow a parent who watches one video to become a subscriber, a customer, and a long-term member of our community.

We’re looking for a Marketing Automation, Copywriting & CRO Specialist to own those systems, write the words that move people through them, and keep improving how well they convert.



Position Summary

The Marketing Automation, Copywriting & CRO Specialist is a contract, hands-on role that combines three things most companies split across several people: owning the marketing automation stack (GoHighLevel, ManyChat,
, CRM, and the integrations between them), writing conversion-focused copy from strategic briefs, and running conversion rate optimization across the funnel. You will take business objectives and customer journeys and turn them into working, tested automations with copy that converts, and you will own the health, reliability, and performance of that infrastructure rather than waiting for individual tasks to be assigned.



This is a great fit for someone who thinks in systems and writes for people, uses AI tools as a natural part of their daily work, troubleshoots before being asked, measures what they ship, and is comfortable operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment with high standards for ownership, responsiveness, and execution.



Key Responsibilities

●	Independently own GoHighLevel (LeadConnector), ManyChat,
 automations, CRM workflows, and the integrations between them.

●	Take a business objective or customer journey and translate it into a working implementation without needing every workflow step designed for you.

●	Build and maintain automations across the full customer lifecycle, including lead capture, segmentation, nurture, abandoned checkout, purchase-triggered sequences, onboarding, upsell, and re-engagement.

●	Develop conversion-focused copy from strategic briefs for
s, SMS, ManyChat flows, landing pages, checkout pages, and other funnel touchpoints.

●	Identify funnel improvements by analyzing where leads and customers drop off, then prioritize what to fix or test.

●	Plan, execute, and measure conversion rate optimization (CRO) efforts, including A/B tests on copy, offers, sequences, timing, and page elements.

●	Understand how our systems connect, from social to ManyChat to CRM to
 to checkout to Stripe to customer status, and keep data flowing cleanly between them.

●	Configure and manage webhooks, APIs, custom fields, tags, triggers, conditions, pipelines, and data passing between systems.

●	Use ChatGPT and other AI tools as part of your daily workflow for problem-solving, technical research, documentation, copy drafting, troubleshooting, and implementation.

●	Use AI-assisted coding for lightweight technical work such as scripts, API requests, webhook logic, JSON, data transformations, debugging, and small internal tools when that is the fastest way to solve the problem.

●	Apply judgment to AI-generated work, whether technical or written. Know when it is reliable and when it needs to be tested, edited, or escalated rather than trusted as-is.

●	Troubleshoot proactively. Identify broken automations, routing issues, duplicate contacts, bad tagging, failed integrations, and customer-journey problems before leadership has to discover them.

●	Test every system end-to-end before considering it complete.

●	Review performance data and distinguish between a technical problem, a funnel or messaging problem, and an issue that needs to be escalated for a strategic decision.

●	Maintain clean system architecture so tags, workflows, fields, and automations stay organized and manageable as the business grows.

●	Document what you build so another qualified person can understand and maintain the system.

●	Communicate clearly when something is blocked, what you need, and what the consequence of the delay is.

●	Take on other systems, automation, and conversion tasks as they arise. This role is expected to flex based on what the business needs from week to week.



Qualifications

●	Demonstrated experience independently designing, implementing, testing, and owning marketing automation systems. We will ask for specific examples and results.

●	Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) or a comparable all-in-one CRM and marketing automation platform, plus ManyChat or a similar conversational automation tool.

●	Proven ability to write conversion-focused copy from a strategic brief, with examples of
s, sequences, or pages you wrote and how they performed.

●	Experience identifying funnel improvements and running optimization efforts, including setting up tests, reading results, and acting on them.

●	Working knowledge of webhooks, APIs, JSON, custom fields, tags, triggers, and data passing between systems. Experience with Stripe and
 marketing platforms is a plus.

●	High proficiency with ChatGPT and other AI tools as a daily part of your workflow, for both technical implementation and copy development.

●	Ability to use AI to increase execution speed without creating fragile systems, technical debt, or generic copy.

●	Understanding of conversion and customer behavior, not just how to operate the software. You should understand why an automation or message exists and what business outcome it is supposed to produce.

●	Strong troubleshooting instincts and attention to detail, with a habit of testing before calling something done.

●	Clear written communication and consistent documentation habits.

●	Ability to work independently and manage your own priorities in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

●	Interest in or familiarity with parenting, coaching, or education businesses is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

●	The automation infrastructure is reliable. Broken workflows, failed integrations, and data issues are caught and fixed before they reach customers or show up in reporting.

●	New customer journeys move from business objective to tested, working automation without leadership designing each step.

●	Every stage of the customer lifecycle, from first contact through purchase, onboarding, and re-engagement, is supported by automations that are built, tested, and maintained.

●	Conversion rates improve at measurable points in the funnel, and the improvements can be traced to specific copy, sequence, or page changes you made.

●	Copy ships on time from strategic briefs, sounds like the brand, and is judged by results rather than by volume.

●	Optimization is a steady practice, not an occasional project. Tests are running, results are documented, and winners are rolled out.

●	Data flows cleanly across social, ManyChat, CRM,
, checkout, Stripe, and customer status, with no duplicate contacts, stray tags, or disconnected workflows.

●	System architecture stays clean and documented, so the business can scale without accumulating technical debt.

●	Performance data is turned into clear diagnoses: what is a technical fix, what is a funnel or messaging problem, and what needs a strategic decision.

●	Blockers are surfaced early, with what is needed and what is at stake, so nothing sits stalled.

●	The systems are not simply running. They are actively owned, improving over time, and creating a smoother, higher-converting path from first interest to engaged, paying customer.



How to Apply

Please send your résumé to 
 with your résumé, include 2–3 examples of automations, workflows, or integrations you have independently designed, built, and owned in GoHighLevel, ManyChat, or comparable platforms. For each, briefly describe the business objective, how you designed and tested the system, and what it produced.

Also include 2–3 samples of conversion-focused copy you wrote from a brief 
s, sequences, or landing pages) and, where possible, the results. If you have run A/B tests or other optimization efforts, tell us what you tested, what you learned, and what changed as a result.

We are especially interested in demonstrated results: how you translate a goal into a system, how you write for conversion rather than volume, and how you know when something is truly working.

title: Senior Mozaik Cabinet Designer & CNC Programmer (Remote – Philippines)
description:
**Company:** Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom  

**Location:** Nashville, Tennessee, USA  

**Work Arrangement:** Remote – Philippines  

**Position:** Full-Time or Part-Time, Long-Term Opportunity  

**Compensation:** Competitive, based on demonstrated experience



## About Our Company



Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom is a growing custom cabinetry and architectural millwork company based in Nashville, Tennessee. We design and manufacture high-quality custom kitchens, built-ins, vanities, closets, and specialty cabinetry for residential construction and remodeling projects.



We operate a **ShopSabre 510 Pro 5' × 10' CNC router** and use **Cyncly Mozaik software** for cabinetry design and CNC manufacturing.



We are looking for an experienced Mozaik specialist who can support our projects from initial architectural drawings through detailed cabinet design, material takeoffs, production documentation, and CNC-ready nesting.



**This is a technical production position, not simply a 3D rendering or drafting position.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Cabinet Design & Technical Drawings

- Interpret architectural plans, floor plans, construction drawings, measurements, and design specifications.

- Develop accurate cabinet layouts for kitchens, bathrooms, closets, built-ins, and custom millwork.

- Create detailed 2D plans, cabinet elevations, sections, and dimensioned shop drawings.

- Develop 3D cabinet models and client-facing renderings.

- Prepare drawings for customer approval and shop production.

- Account for appliance specifications, fillers, scribes, reveals, toe kicks, clearances, and installation requirements.

- Identify missing dimensions and potential design or construction conflicts before production.



### 2. Material Takeoffs & Estimating

- Generate accurate cabinet and project material takeoffs.

- Prepare detailed cut lists, part lists, and bills of materials (BOM).

- Calculate sheet goods, hardwood components, cabinet hardware, edge banding, and other required materials.

- Assist with material quantities, waste calculations, and project cost estimates.

- Organize production information for purchasing and scheduling.



### 3. Mozaik Programming & CNC Nesting

- Build and maintain cabinet libraries, construction methods, materials, and hardware configurations within Mozaik.

- Create CNC-ready nested sheet layouts optimized for material utilization.

- Configure machining operations, including drilling, dados, grooves, pockets, and cutouts.

- Understand tooling, cutter diameters, kerf allowances, tool compensation, and machining tolerances.

- Apply appropriate toolpaths, lead-ins, tabs or onion-skin strategies where required.

- Work with our production team to ensure Mozaik output is compatible with our ShopSabre 510 Pro CNC router.

- Understand post-processors, G-code output, and CNC file preparation.

- Verify part orientation, grain direction, edge banding, and machining operations before releasing files.

- Troubleshoot nesting or programming issues and improve cutting efficiency.



### 4. Production Documentation & Quality Control

- Produce complete manufacturing packages, including approved drawings, cut lists, nesting sheets, part labels, and assembly information.

- Ensure cabinet dimensions and specifications match approved designs.

- Maintain organized project files, drawing revisions, and production records.

- Coordinate remotely with our shop team to resolve technical questions.

- Review production feedback and improve future programming accuracy.



## Required Qualifications



- **Demonstrated professional experience using Cyncly Mozaik software.**

- Strong understanding of custom cabinetry construction and manufacturing.

- Experience creating detailed cabinet elevations, shop drawings, and 3D models.

- Experience generating material takeoffs, cut lists, and bills of materials.

- Hands-on experience with CNC nesting and manufacturing file preparation.

- **Proven ability to produce cut-ready output directly from Mozaik:** optimized nested sheet layouts, part labels, and CNC files that can go straight to the router with no rework on our end.

- Experience setting up and optimizing Mozaik nesting: sheet sizes, part spacing, kerf and tool diameter allowances, grain matching, small-part handling, and remnant/offcut reuse to minimize waste.

- Ability to produce dimensioned, cut-ready shop drawings (plans, elevations, sections, and part details) that the shop can build from without further interpretation.

- Experience verifying nests before release: checking part counts, machining on the correct face, hole and dado placement, edge banding, and grain direction.

- Must be able to share real examples of nesting sheets and cut-ready drawings you personally produced in Mozaik.

- Knowledge of cabinet joinery, hardware placement, construction tolerances, and machining requirements.

- Ability to read U.S. architectural and construction drawings.

- Comfortable working with inches, feet, and fractional measurements.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Previous experience programming ShopSabre CNC routers.

- Experience with Mozaik CNC, Mozaik Manufacturing, and post-processor configuration.

- Familiarity with VCarve, Aspire, AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar programs.

- Experience with frameless and face-frame cabinetry, inset doors, and custom millwork.

- Knowledge of U.S. cabinetry standards, hardware systems, and installation practices.

- Experience supporting a U.S.-based cabinet manufacturer remotely.



## What Success Looks Like



Our goal is to have a reliable remote technical specialist who can take a project from architectural plans to a complete, accurate, shop-ready production package.



The ideal candidate will help us reduce design time, minimize material waste, prevent manufacturing mistakes, and increase the number of projects our shop can produce efficiently.



We value accuracy, accountability, clear communication, and long-term professional relationships.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your resume and a brief description of your cabinetry and Mozaik experience.

2. How many years you have used Mozaik professionally, including which versions and modules.

3. Examples of cabinet elevations, 3D renderings, shop drawings, material takeoffs, and CNC nesting layouts you have personally created.

4. Details of the CNC machines and post-processors you have worked with.

5. Your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation in USD.

6. Your availability and ability to overlap working hours with our Nashville, Tennessee team.



**Important:** Start your application with the words **"MOZAIK CNC SPECIALIST"** so we know you have read the complete posting.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview and a paid practical skills assessment using a sample cabinetry project.



We are looking for someone who can become a valued long-term member of our production team.



**Tom Bell Cabinetry & Custom**  

Nashville, Tennessee, USA

title: WIX Studio Web Designer + SEO Specialist
description:
We are a small US-based AI automation and marketing agency in Texas. We build websites for local businesses that are fast, polished, and built to rank - our clients prefer the simplicity of WIX, and we need an expert in-house WIX Studio creator.



We are seeking a web designer who ALREADY uses AI tools to move fast, and who has the design and coding (CSS/Javascript) skills to make every site look custom, NOT TEMPLATED. You will also own on-site SEO and must have ADVANCED English / Copywriting skills.



You will be responsible for:



Website Builds



• Building complete, polished websites in Wix Studio from brief to launch

• Delivering single-page sites within 24 to 48 hours with minimal revisions

• Designing mobile-first, with smooth effects, transitions, and interactions on every site

• Using AI tools to speed up structure and layout, then applying your own design and code to make it custom

• Writing and refining website copy that fits each client’s business type and audience

• Using Velo, custom CSS, and custom code when a design goes beyond Wix’s standard tools



On-Site SEO



• Building SEO into every site from the start, including heading structure, metadata, alt text, internal linking, schema, and page speed

• Researching keywords and building new service and location pages that rank on the sites we maintain

• Writing and publishing regular on-site content to increase SEO performance

• Monitoring Google Search Console and fixing indexing, speed, and technical SEO issues before they become problems



You are a fit if:



1. You have advanced Wix Studio skills and a portfolio of live Wix sites you built yourself

2. You can write custom code in CSS, and Velo (JavaScript) and it comes easy

3. Your design work looks custom, not templated. Spacing, typography, and motion matter to you.

4. You use AI tools every day in your workflow and know where they fall short

5. You have real on-site SEO experience and can show pages you built that rank

6. Your written English is advanced. You will be responsible for website copy and blog content.

7. You work fast without cutting corners, and you don’t need reminders to hit deadlines



This is not the right fit if you do not understand CSS/Javascript, if you can only build with AI, or if SEO optimization is an afterthought.



Schedule and Compensation

Full time, 40 hours per week, US Central business hours.

$900 - $1,100 per month depending on experience, paid weekly.



To Apply

Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Include:



1. Links to 3+ live Wix Studio sites you built yourself. Tell us what AI helped with and what you are most proud of.

2. What are the first things you do to increase the SEO/AEO of a website?

title: Instagram DM Setter, Full-Time, US Hours, Perfect English
description:
We run the Instagram inbox for a growing US marketing agency and we need one more person on the team who can turn a DM conversation into a booked phone call. You will be replying to business owners who message us from our ads, following up with the ones who went quiet, and getting them to say yes to a 10-minute call with our phone team. You will be writing as the face of the company, so your English has to be flawless. If it is, and you like the feeling of turning a cold "Info" into a booked call, keep reading.



About us



We are a US marketing agency that helps home service businesses across the United States (junk removal, moving, landscaping, electrical, plumbing, detailing, and similar trades) get consistent jobs from Instagram. We run their ads, build their brand with content, and put the follow-up systems in place so the leads turn into booked work. Everything starts in our Instagram inbox: hundreds of business owners reply to our ads every month, and the DM setter is the first person they talk to.

We are a small, direct team: two co-founders, a phone setter, two DM setters, and client success. You will report directly to one of the co-founders and work alongside the other setters every day.



What you will do every day

• Reply to new Instagram DMs from business owners who responded to our ads, within minutes, in a natural, conversational voice.

• Ask the right questions to understand their business, find out what they want more of, and get them to say yes to a 10-minute phone call with our phone setter.

• Book that call: confirm the time in their time zone, collect their name,
 and phone number, put it on the calendar, and make sure they got the confirmation.

• Follow up with every conversation that went quiet, using our written follow-up sequences, and bring old leads back to life.

• Handle objections in writing ("how much is it?", "send me info", "I'm busy", "I've been burned before") the way our playbook lays out, without ever quoting a price in the DM.

• Log every booking in your tracking sheet and post a short end-of-day report in Slack.

• Join team Zoom calls for training, call reviews and feedback, camera on.



The target is 5 booked calls per day. We give you the scripts, the follow-up sequences, the objection playbook and an AI assistant trained on our best conversations. You bring the English, the attention and the follow-through.



Must-haves

• Perfect written English. Not good, not fluent: perfect. Natural American phrasing, correct spelling and punctuation, and the ability to sound like a relaxed business owner texting another business owner. Every message you send is read by a US customer as if the founder wrote it. This is the first thing we screen for and there are no exceptions.

• Clear spoken English and comfort on camera. You will be on Zoom with the team for training and reviews, camera on, several times a week.

• Full-time availability during US hours. 40 to 60 hours a week, scheduled across US daytime and evening hours including weekend coverage on a rotation. Leads reply at all hours and we need someone there when they do.

• A quiet place to work, a reliable laptop and stable internet with a backup. Power and internet outages cannot take you offline for a whole shift.

• At least one year of experience in a customer-facing writing role: Instagram or
 
 setting, appointment setting, chat sales, customer support chat, or similar.

• Attention to detail. You will track every booking, every follow-up and every handle, and your numbers get checked against the inbox data.

• Coachable and consistent. We review conversations every week and expect the feedback to show up in the next day's messages.



Nice-to-haves

• Experience setting appointments for a marketing agency, coaching business or any US service business.

• Familiarity with Instagram's inbox, Slack, Google Sheets and GoHighLevel.

• Experience with home service businesses (junk removal, landscaping, trades) or with selling to small business owners.

• A track record you can show: screenshots of booked calls, a previous employer's reference, or results from a similar role.

Hours, pay and how we work

• Schedule: full-time, 40 to 60 hours a week, US hours. We will agree your exact shift at the interview based on your availability and the team's coverage.

• Pay: a competitive monthly base paid on time, plus performance pay tied to booked calls that show up. We do not publish a number here on purpose: we pay more for a strong candidate than for an average one, and we would rather see how you write and talk first. We will be specific about the full structure in the interview.

• Start: as soon as you clear the trial. The first two weeks are paid training with daily feedback, and you will be live in the inbox within the first few days.

• Growth: our setters have moved into senior setter and team lead roles as the agency has grown. We are hiring because volume is up, not to replace anyone.

• Tools we provide: scripts, follow-up sequences, an objection playbook, a tracking sheet, and an AI assistant trained on our best conversations.



How to apply

We read every application that follows these steps and skip the ones that don't. This is the first test of attention to detail.

1. Put the word INBOX as the first word of your subject line or message.

2. In three to five sentences, tell us about the most relevant work you've done and your current availability in US Central time (which days, which hours, how many hours a week).

3. Reply to this DM as if you were our setter. A business owner answered our ad with: "How much does it cost? I run a small landscaping company, mostly word of mouth right now." Write the exact message you would send back. Do not quote a price.

4. Record a 60 to 90 second video (Loom or any link) introducing yourself in English, camera on, and tell us why you want this role. No script, just talk.

5. Attach or link one piece of proof: screenshots of booked appointments, a reference, or anything that shows you've done this before.

Shortlisted candidates get a written test (five real DM conversations to reply to), then a Zoom interview with one of the co-founders where we go through your answers, the schedule and the full pay structure. If both sides are happy, you start a paid two-week trial.



Short summary (shows in search results): US marketing agency hiring a full-time Instagram DM setter to reply to inbound leads, follow up, and book 10-minute phone calls. Perfect written English, camera-on Zoom training, 40 to 60 hrs/week on US hours. Pay discussed at interview, higher for strong candidates. Apply with the word INBOX and a sample DM reply.

Skills to tag: Appointment Setting, Instagram Marketing, Chat Support, Lead Generation, Social Media Management, English Writing, Sales

Salary field: leave as "Negotiable" or enter a range only if the platform requires one.

Tip for screening: anyone whose message does not start with INBOX, or whose sample reply quotes a price, is out before you read the rest. Of the ones left, read the sample reply first and the video second; the resume last.

description:
Lead Generation Caller | U.S. Managed IT Services Company (MSP)



Remote, Philippines | Full-Time Independent Contractor | U.S. Pacific Time Hours



Join the Crown Computers team, where we have been helping businesses get more from their technology since 1996.



At Crown Computers, our goal is to provide our clients with Technology Peace of Mind, and we believe great service starts with a team that is supported, developed, and empowered to do great work.



People matter here.



We are intentionally building a culture centered around customer service, accountability, teamwork, integrity, ownership, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and professional growth.



Crown Computers is an established Managed Services Provider (MSP) based in San Diego, California. We help small and medium-sized businesses succeed by providing managed IT services, cybersecurity, Microsoft technologies, cloud solutions, and technical support.



We are looking for an experienced Lead Generation Caller to join our team remotely from the Philippines and help us connect with businesses that could benefit from our services.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who enjoys speaking with people, takes pride in their work, and wants to contribute to the growth of an established U.S. company.



Job Description



As our Lead Generation Caller, you will be responsible for reaching out to prospective business clients, introducing Crown Computers, identifying potential opportunities, and scheduling qualified introductory meetings for our sales team.



You will primarily speak with business owners, office managers, and other decision-makers in the San Diego area.



We are looking for someone who understands that successful appointment setting is about building trust, asking thoughtful questions, and creating genuine interest, not simply reading a script or making as many calls as possible.



This is a newly created role with an opportunity to help shape and improve our lead generation process as Crown continues to grow.



Compensation & Benefits



Monthly Compensation



$1,500 USD per month in base contractor compensation, guaranteed and paid twice monthly by bank transfer.



Appointment Bonus



$50 USD for every qualified appointment that takes place, paid from the first one, with no monthly minimum and no cap.



Signing Bonus



$200 USD for every business that signs a managed services agreement with Crown within 90 days of a meeting you booked, paid on signature, with no cap.



What Counts as a Qualified Appointment



The meeting takes place, and the attendee is the owner, a partner, the CEO, CFO or COO, or the office or operations manager who makes IT decisions for the business. A receptionist, assistant or IT technician does not count, even if they agreed to the meeting. A rescheduled meeting that takes place counts. A meeting that never takes place does not. Our team records the outcome of each meeting in GoHighLevel, where you can see it.



What This Adds Up To



At 10 held appointments and 1 signed client in a month, total compensation is $2,200 USD. At 20 held appointments and 2 signed clients, it is $2,900 USD. The first two weeks are a ramp with lower dial targets while you learn our services, so expect the first month to be mostly base.



Paid Time Off



This engagement includes 10 days of paid time off annually, subject to the terms of the contractor agreement.



Paid Holidays



Crown provides 7 paid holidays annually, with the holiday schedule established as part of the contractor engagement.



Professional Development



We invest in our team through regular coaching, feedback, skill development, and opportunities to contribute ideas and improve our processes.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking to establish a lasting professional relationship with someone who values accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional growth.



Work Schedule



Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Pacific Time



Each day includes a one-hour lunch break and two 15-minute breaks, one in the morning and one in the afternoon. That is 40 working hours per week.



Because our clients are located in California, this position requires working overnight hours in the Philippines.



Philippine Time (Manila):



- 12:00 AM to 9:00 AM during U.S. Standard Time (approximately November through early March)

- 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM during U.S. Daylight Saving Time (approximately March through early November)



Candidates must be comfortable maintaining this schedule on a long-term basis.



Responsibilities



In this role, you will:



- Make outbound calls to prospective U.S. businesses using GoHighLevel and its power dialing tools.

- Contact business owners, office managers, and other decision-makers to introduce Crown Computers and our IT services.

- Work from targeted prospect lists provided by our team.

- Follow up with businesses that may have received our introductory marketing
s.

- Ask thoughtful discovery questions to understand prospects' current IT challenges and business needs.

- Communicate the value of Crown's managed IT services and identify opportunities for introductory meetings.

- Schedule qualified appointments with our sales team and accurately document relevant information.

- Maintain organized call notes, prospect records, and follow-up activities in our CRM.

- Track and report calling activity, conversations, appointments scheduled, and appointments completed.

- Participate in regular coaching sessions and call reviews to continuously improve results.

- Collaborate with our sales and leadership teams to refine messaging, improve processes, and increase appointment quality.



Qualifications



Required Qualifications



- Proven experience making outbound B2B cold calls to U.S. businesses.

- Demonstrated experience scheduling qualified introductory sales appointments.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with clear pronunciation and the ability to communicate naturally and confidently with U.S. business owners.

- Strong listening skills and the ability to ask effective discovery questions.

- Confidence handling objections professionally and maintaining a positive, respectful attitude.

- Experience working with CRM platforms and outbound calling tools.

- Ability to track calling activity, conversations, appointments, and results.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, accountability, and consistent follow-through.

- Ability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours consistently on a long-term basis.

- A reliable computer, stable internet connection, quality headset, and backup internet or power arrangements.



Preferred Qualifications



- Previous cold-calling experience with a Managed Services Provider (MSP), IT services company, cybersecurity company, or technology business.

- Experience using GoHighLevel or similar power dialing tools.

- Previous experience working overnight shifts aligned with U.S. business hours.

- Familiarity with managed IT services, cybersecurity, or technology-related business challenges.



What Success Looks Like



The right person for this position enjoys making calls and understands that every conversation is an opportunity to build a professional relationship.



You are comfortable speaking with busy decision-makers, asking questions, listening carefully, and communicating with confidence.



You are persistent without being pushy, and you understand the importance of representing our company professionally, even when someone is not interested.



You take ownership of your results, welcome constructive feedback, and enjoy improving your skills over time.



We value quality conversations and meaningful appointments, not simply call volume.



An Opportunity to Make an Impact



This is a new position at Crown Computers, and you will have an opportunity to help us build a successful and repeatable outbound lead generation process.



We already have prospect lists, calling tools, introductory marketing campaigns, and an initial approach. We are looking for someone who can help us put these resources to work while contributing ideas and improvements based on real-world calling experience.



You will receive coaching, feedback, and opportunities to work directly with our sales and leadership teams.

The successful candidate will provide services to Crown Computers under an independent contractor agreement, with compensation paid in U.S. dollars.

title: Care Specialist
description:

Interviews will be scheduled for Sunday afternoon Pacific Time.



We're a fast-moving healthcare operations team that handles prior authorizations (PAs) for infusion clinic. We're building a team of sharp, hungry operators to help us do it at scale.



As a Care Specialist, you'll be on the front lines — initiating PA requests, verifying insurance benefits, navigating payer portals and phone systems, and documenting cases accurately in our internal platform. You'll work directly with our team leads and report into operations leadership.



Warning: this is not an easy job. The learning curve is steep and the pace is fast— every case you touch is a patient waiting on treatment. We'll train you on the content, but we can't train work ethic, attention to detail, or the drive to push through hard problems. If you want comfortable, this isn't it. If you want growth, you’ll fit right in.



What You'll Do

Initiate prior authorization requests with insurance payers via online portals and phone calls

Accurately document case details, call notes, and outcomes in our internal case management platform

Navigate complex payer phone trees and hold times without losing steam

Identify when cases hit non-standard situations and escalate or problem-solve proactively

Follow SOPs closely while flagging gaps or process improvement opportunities

Manage a live queue of cases across multiple statuses — nothing falls through the cracks



You're a Great Fit If You Are...

Hungry and self-driven

You don't wait to be told what to do next — you find the next task

You want to grow fast and take on more responsibility over time



Obsessively detail-oriented

You catch errors others miss - wrong codes, missing fields, inconsistent info

You don't submit work you're not sure about

You understand that one mistake in a PA form can delay a patient's treatment by weeks



A fast, independent learner

You can read a new SOP and execute it correctly within a few days

You ask smart clarifying questions before going down the wrong path

You're comfortable not knowing everything on day one and excited to learn



A creative problem-solver

When a case hits an edge case, you think before you escalate

You come to your manager with a proposed solution, not just a problem

You document what happened so the next person doesn't hit the same wall



Resilient and relentless

Hold times, rejections, and ambiguous situations don't demoralize you

You stay focused through repetitive tasks without cutting corners

Requirements

Strong written and spoken English - you'll communicate with US insurance reps and clinic staff

Comfortable working US business hours (EST or PST overlap required)

Tech-comfortable — you can navigate multiple browser tabs, portals, and spreadsheets simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment

What You Don't Need

A medical or clinical background — we'll teach you what you need to know about PAs and insurance. You just need to be a fast learner.

Years of experience — we care far more about how you think and how hard you work



What We Offer

Above-market starting pay — we pay more than most entry-level BPO or VA roles because we expect more

Performance bonuses — hit your targets, earn more. Hustle is rewarded directly

Formal 4-month review — we evaluate and adjust compensation fast, not on a yearly corporate clock

Solid career growth path — PA Agent ? Senior PA Agent ? Team Lead. We promote from within and we're growing very fast

Ground-floor opportunity — you're joining early. The people who build with us now are the ones who lead later

Fully Remote

Please do not use AI-generated retouching, AI beauty filters, Facetune, or one-click skin-smoothing applications.



Photos must preserve natural skin texture, realistic proportions, and accurate permanent makeup results.

* Proven experience in high-end beauty or portrait photo retouching.

* Proficiency in professional photo-editing software.

* Strong understanding of manual retouching techniques, including skin cleanup, dodge & burn, colour correction, and texture preservation.

* Experience creating reels or short-form videos.

* Reliable, organised, and able to meet deadlines.

* Experience with beauty, skincare, cosmetics, or permanent makeup is preferred.

* Interest in social media management is an advantage.



What This Role Offers



* Flexible remote work.

* Creative work in the beauty and permanent makeup industry.

* Ongoing freelance or part-time opportunities.

* The chance to take on more responsibility as the business grows.

* Potential progression into social media management.

2. Creating a short reel based on a provided example.

How to Apply

2. Before-and-after examples demonstrating your manual editing skills.

I’m looking for someone reliable, creative, and passionate about creating high-quality beauty content. This could become a long-term opportunity for the right person.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Chief of Staff – Operations, Growth & Marketing



Company: Rentercasa

Location: Remote – Philippines

Schedule: Full-Time | U.S. Eastern Time

Salary: ₱120,000–₱200,000 PHP per month, based on experience and leadership ability



About Rentercasa

Rentercasa is a growing U.S.-based property management company specializing in co-living, room rentals, and residential property management.



We are looking for an experienced Chief of Staff who can help run the business, manage department leaders, improve performance, and drive growth.



This is NOT a Virtual Assistant or administrative position. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who can manage managers, analyze KPIs, solve problems, improve systems, and turn company goals into execution. You will report directly to the Founder.



Who You Will Manage

• Operations Manager

• Leasing Manager

• Marketing Manager/Specialist

• Collections Manager

• Other team leads as assigned



Your responsibility is to make sure these departments work together and consistently achieve their goals.



Main Responsibilities



Operations & Execution

• Turn company goals into actionable plans.

• Hold managers accountable for deadlines and results.

• Lead weekly management and accountability meetings.

• Monitor departmental KPIs.

• Identify operational problems and implement solutions.

• Coordinate projects involving multiple departments.

• Improve communication between teams.

• Ensure company policies and SOPs are followed.

• Reduce routine operational issues requiring Founder involvement.



Maintain an executive dashboard and provide weekly reporting on performance, missed targets, risks, opportunities, and matters requiring executive decisions.



Co-Living Operations

Oversee performance across the entire co-living lifecycle: Property Onboarding → Room Readiness → Marketing → Lead Generation → Leasing → Move-In → Resident Management → Collections → Retention → Turnover.



Monitor property onboarding, room readiness, occupancy, vacancies, resident onboarding, leasing, collections, delinquency, evictions, maintenance coordination, inspections, room turns, and resident and owner escalations.



Leasing & Occupancy

Work closely with the Leasing Manager to ensure rooms are getting filled. Track occupancy, vacant rooms, days vacant, leads, response times, tours, applications, approvals, move-ins, conversion rates, and leasing-agent productivity. When rooms are sitting vacant, work with Leasing, Marketing, and Operations to identify the cause and implement an immediate action plan.



Marketing Management

Supervise the Marketing Manager/Specialist and ensure marketing generates measurable business results. Oversee property advertising, listing performance, social media, lead-generation campaigns,
 and SMS campaigns, referral marketing, local marketing, owner-acquisition campaigns, partnerships, and new marketing channels.



Marketing will be measured by qualified leads, cost per lead, conversions, occupancy generated, owner leads, and marketing ROI—not simply the number of posts created.



Collections & Revenue

Supervise the Collections Manager and monitor collection percentage, delinquency, past-due balances, payment commitments, eviction status, bad debt, and resident payment trends. Ensure collection procedures are consistently followed and financial risks are addressed quickly.



Business Development & Growth

Help grow Rentercasa's management portfolio by developing relationships with property owners, real estate investors, Realtors, brokers, builders, housing organizations, employers, nonprofits, referral partners, and strategic partners.



Maintain a measurable business-development pipeline and track owner leads, sales meetings, proposals, follow-ups, signed management agreements, properties and rooms added, pipeline value, and conversion rates. Assist with new-market expansion, strategic partnerships, portfolio acquisitions, and other growth opportunities.



KPI & Performance Management

Own the company-wide management scorecard. When a KPI is missed: Identify the problem → Determine the cause → Create a corrective action plan → Assign accountability → Follow up → Measure improvement.



You must be comfortable managing a business through numbers and measurable results.



People Leadership

Manage department heads, conduct weekly accountability meetings, review manager scorecards, establish priorities, identify staffing and training needs, address performance problems early, and build a culture of ownership, urgency, communication, and accountability.



Systems, SOPs & Automation

• Create and improve SOPs.

• Document workflows.

• Eliminate unnecessary manual work.

• Identify automation opportunities.

• Use AI to improve efficiency.

• Audit processes.

• Improve reporting and communication.

• Ensure company systems contain accurate information.



Experience with Google Workspace, Rentvine, Follow Up Boss, CRMs, property-management software, project-management systems, and marketing platforms is helpful.



Special Projects

Lead projects involving new-market launches, new service offerings, portfolio acquisitions, technology implementations, operational restructuring, marketing initiatives, strategic partnerships, process improvements, and company expansion.



Who We're Looking For

• Thinks like an operator, not an assistant.

• Comfortable managing managers.

• Takes ownership without constant direction.

• Understands KPIs and dashboards.

• Can analyze numbers and identify problems.

• Can move between strategy and hands-on execution.

• Understands sales, business development, and marketing.

• Can manage multiple departments simultaneously.

• Communicates professionally and clearly.

• Is comfortable challenging underperformance.

• Solves problems instead of simply reporting them.



Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of operations, leadership, project management, real estate, property management, hospitality, co-living, or related experience.

• Experience supervising managers or team leaders.

• Experience working with U.S.-based companies.

• Experience managing remote teams.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Strong Google Workspace skills.

• Experience with KPIs, dashboards, CRMs, and performance reporting.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Property management or real estate experience strongly preferred.



What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, we expect you to establish clear departmental KPIs, implement a company-wide management scorecard, establish weekly manager accountability meetings, improve visibility into occupancy and financial performance, identify operational bottlenecks, strengthen cross-department communication, improve owner service, and build a measurable business-development pipeline.



Ultimately, success means: Rooms are getting filled. Collections are performing. Managers are accountable. Owners receive excellent service. Marketing produces measurable results. The portfolio is growing. Problems are solved quickly. The Founder can focus on strategy and expansion.



Compensation

₱120,000–₱150,000 PHP per month



Final compensation will be based on experience, demonstrated leadership ability, and qualifications. This is a full-time, long-term position working primarily during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



How to Apply

1. Submit your resume.

2. Provide a brief explanation of your experience managing teams or managers.

3. Provide an example of a KPI or scorecard you have previously managed.

4. Describe a business or operational problem you identified and solved.

5. Submit a 1–2 minute introduction video explaining who you are, your leadership experience, your experience managing managers or departments, and why you would be an excellent Chief of Staff for Rentercasa.



Applications without the requested information and introduction video may not be considered.

title: Client Success & Onboarding Manager
description:
AYARX | Telehealth Provider Network

Position Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote

Industry: Telehealth / Healthcare Services / SaaS



About the Role



AYARX is seeking a highly organized, resourceful, and patient Client Success & Onboarding Manager to serve as the primary point of contact for new clients once a sale is closed.

We work with telehealth companies at various stages of growth, from established healthcare brands to early-stage startups launching their first services. Some clients have fully developed systems and workflows, while others need significant guidance in understanding how to launch and operate a telehealth business.

This role requires someone who can confidently take ownership of the client relationship, guide clients through onboarding, coordinate with internal and external teams, and help turn ideas into functional workflows.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who has the patience to guide inexperienced clients, the stamina to navigate startup environments, and the ability to build strong, mutually beneficial relationships.



Key Responsibilities

1. Client Onboarding & Relationship Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients following contract execution.

Welcome new clients, conduct kickoff meetings, and establish clear expectations, timelines, responsibilities, and next steps.

Guide clients through onboarding, whether integrating with a third-party telehealth platform or using their own internal systems.

Maintain regular communication, provide progress updates, and proactively address questions or roadblocks.

Build long-term relationships that promote client satisfaction, retention, and growth.

2. Workflow Development & Implementation

Work with clients to understand their business model, patient journey, treatment offerings, and operational needs.

Help develop and document workflows covering patient intake, provider consultations, prescribing, follow-ups, escalations, and communication.

Coordinate with clinical, operations, technology, and platform teams to ensure workflows are practical and properly implemented.

Identify operational gaps and help clients develop solutions before launch.

Coordinate testing, training, and launch readiness.

3. Client Education & Guidance

Provide hands-on guidance to clients who are new to telehealth or unfamiliar with healthcare operations.

Explain provider network capabilities, general licensing considerations, telehealth workflows, and operational requirements.

Help clients understand the differences between clinical responsibilities, platform responsibilities, and administrative support.

Set realistic expectations while maintaining a supportive, solutions-oriented approach.

Know when to escalate clinical, regulatory, or legal questions to the appropriate professionals rather than independently interpreting requirements.

4. Cross-Functional Coordination

Act as the liaison between clients, AYARX's clinical and operations teams, and external SaaS/platform partners.

Track onboarding milestones, outstanding requirements, deliverables, and launch dates.

Coordinate provider availability, state coverage requirements, platform access, and workflow approvals with the appropriate internal teams.

Ensure smooth handoffs and clear accountability across all parties.

Continue managing client relationships after launch, including troubleshooting, service improvements, and identifying expansion opportunities.



Required Qualifications



Experience in client success, account management, implementation, or onboarding within telehealth, healthcare services, or healthcare SaaS.

Working knowledge of HIPAA, patient privacy, and healthcare data-handling practices.

Familiarity with EMRs/EHRs, telehealth platforms, patient intake systems, and related SaaS tools.

Basic understanding of U.S. provider licensing, state-specific telehealth considerations, and clinical versus non-clinical responsibilities.

Experience developing, documenting, or improving operational workflows and SOPs.

Strong project management, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities independently.

Comfortable leading meetings, educating clients, and communicating with founders, executives, clinicians, and technical teams.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with telehealth startups, digital health companies, or white-label healthcare services.

Familiarity with GLP-1 weight management, hormone therapy, wellness, or other cash-pay telehealth programs.

Experience coordinating integrations or implementations involving multiple vendors and software platforms.

Background in healthcare operations, provider networks, or clinical support services.



The Personality We're Looking For



Technical knowledge is important, but the right temperament is essential.

Our ideal candidate is:

Exceptionally patient: Comfortable answering the same questions repeatedly and guiding clients who may have little understanding of telehealth operations.

Proactive and resourceful: Doesn't wait for clients to figure out what they need. Anticipates problems, identifies gaps, and proposes next steps.

Resilient and adaptable: Thrives in fast-moving startup environments where priorities shift, timelines change, and processes are still being developed.

A natural relationship builder: Knows how to make clients feel supported while maintaining professional boundaries and accountability.

Confident but diplomatic: Can manage demanding personalities, push back when necessary, and communicate limitations without damaging relationships.

Detail-oriented and accountable: Follows through, documents decisions, and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.

A problem solver, not just a messenger: Takes ownership of issues and works toward resolution rather than simply forwarding
s between teams.



What Success Looks Like



New clients experience a structured, organized, and welcoming onboarding process.

Clients clearly understand what AYARX provides, what their platform provides, and what remains their responsibility.

Onboarding milestones and launch timelines are actively managed.

Workflows are documented, tested, and operationally ready before launch.

Clients feel supported without becoming unnecessarily dependent on the team for routine decisions.

Internal teams receive clear, complete requirements with minimal confusion or repeated follow-ups.

Client relationships remain productive, professional, and mutually beneficial beyond the initial launch.



Why Join AYARX?



AYARX supports telehealth businesses across the United States by providing access to a nationwide network of licensed healthcare professionals and clinical infrastructure.

You'll play a central role in helping healthcare brands successfully launch, operate, and scale their services. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving operational challenges, and bringing structure to fast-growing businesses.

We're not looking for someone who simply manages accounts. We're looking for someone who can take a newly signed client, guide them through uncertainty, build their confidence, and turn the relationship into a successful long-term partnership.

How to Apply



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph.

Submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph and briefly introduce yourself. Please mention “ Client Success & Onboarding Manager” in your application.



Step 2: Complete our short application form.

Please fill out this form so we can review your experience, skills, availability, and expected rate:

Application Form:  

The form should take approximately 3-5 minutes to complete.





We will prioritize applicants who have completed both steps and can interview immediately.





IMPORTANT

We are looking for someone with practical experience who can contribute from day one. Please be prepared to discuss campaigns you have personally managed and share examples of your work or measurable results where possible.



We are looking to interview and hire immediately, so please apply only if you are available to start soon.

description:
ABOUT ISAAC HEALTH



Isaac Health is a fast-growing Series A-stage startup specializing in dementia and brain health care through our multidisciplinary virtual memory clinic. Operating across all 50 states, we partner with payers nationwide to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care.



As we expand, we are seeking a dedicated, detail-oriented, and highly organized Medical Biller to join our team. You will play a vital role in our revenue cycle, ensuring the financial health of our clinic while minimizing billing friction for our patients and their caregivers.



ROLE OVERVIEW



This role acts as a core pillar of our financial operations and revenue cycle management. You will be responsible for critical billing functions, including payment posting, secondary claim submission, benefit verification, and patient invoicing. You’ll primarily support our clinical and administrative teams by ensuring that services are accurately billed and collected, while also assisting patients with their financial inquiries. The position blends financial and administrative precision with a patient-first mindset. The ideal candidate is adept at navigating complex insurance guidelines, resolves billing discrepancies efficiently, and can communicate financial obligations clearly and empathetically to older adults and their families.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Billing & Claims Management

- Manage the accurate and timely creation and submission of secondary claims to ensure maximum reimbursement.

- Execute daily payment posting, ensuring all payments, adjustments, and denials from insurance payers and patients are correctly applied and reconciled in our system.



Patient Financial Services & Invoicing

- Perform thorough eligibility of benefits (EOB) verifications prior to appointments, ensuring active coverage and understanding of patient responsibility.

- Generate, review, and process patient invoices, serving as a helpful resource for patients and caregivers who have questions about their bills or out-of-pocket costs.



Administrative & Revenue Support

- Collaborate closely with the intake, front desk, and clinical teams to ensure all patient demographic and insurance information is accurately captured for clean claim submission.

- Deliver a “white glove” financial experience by handling billing inquiries and resolving disputes or claim denials quickly and empathetically.



REQUIREMENTS

- 2–3+ years of experience in medical billing, revenue cycle management, or healthcare financial services

- Demonstrated expertise in payment posting, secondary claim submission, and verifying eligibility of benefits

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex billing and insurance concepts clearly and empathetically to older adults

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple financial priorities with a high degree of accuracy

- Familiarity with medical billing software, clearinghouses, EMRs, and collaboration tools (e.g., Google Workspace)

- Reliable high-speed internet connection

- Must be available to work U.S. business hours (Eastern Time)



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, fully remote role (40+ hours/week)

- Competitive compensation with opportunities for advancement

- A stable, long-term position with a mission-driven U.S. healthcare company

- Training and mentorship in dementia care operations and billing excellence

- Career progression opportunities in revenue cycle management, financial operations, or billing leadership

- A chance to shape the future of dementia and brain health care delivery

2. Project Management & Coordination — 35%

• Conduct project kickoff communications with customers and assigned craftsmen.

• Develop project timelines, milestone schedules, and task lists.

3. Customer Service & Relationship Management — 20%

• Answer incoming calls,
s, and customer inquiries as part of the customer service team.

title: Marketing Director
description:
About Starbond



Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand specializing in high-quality adhesives and related products. We sell through Shopify, Amazon, and other e-commerce and B2B channels.



We are building a more disciplined, data-driven Marketing function and are looking for a Marketing Director who can turn customer insight, strong execution, and sound unit economics into profitable, scalable growth.



About the Role



The Marketing Director will own the design, performance, and continuous improvement of Starbond’s Marketing function. This leader will establish the strategy, team structure, systems, decision rights, reporting, and cross-functional cadence required to drive profitable growth.



This is not a high-level advisory role. Starbond is still developing its marketing infrastructure, so the Marketing Director must be comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You must be able to personally calculate, validate, and explain the numbers behind marketing performance—not rely solely on dashboards, agencies, or reports prepared by others.



You will oversee DTC growth across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion rate optimization, brand, and agency performance.



Key Responsibilities



Marketing Strategy and Leadership

Set annual and quarterly Marketing strategies, priorities, resource plans, and measurable outcomes.

Build a scalable Marketing operating model with clear workflows, decision rights, quality standards, and accountability.

Assess and improve the team’s structure, capabilities, tools, data, agencies, and cross-functional handoffs.

Develop capable leaders and owners beneath the role so execution does not depend on constant intervention.

Set team KPIs, coaching cadences, performance standards, succession plans, and corrective actions.

Provide the CEO with concise, financially grounded updates on results, risks, constraints, and recommended decisions.



Profitable DTC Growth

Own integrated DTC growth across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, AEO, social media, content, CRO, and other relevant channels.

Establish acceptable acquisition thresholds by product, channel, campaign, customer segment, and cohort.

Determine when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue marketing investments.

Connect marketing plans with inventory, operational capacity, product readiness, and financial objectives.

Ensure marketing decisions prioritize profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone.



Marketing Analytics and Unit Economics

Personally calculate and validate CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC payback, MER, ROAS, gross margin, contribution margin, conversion rates, retention, cohort performance, and other funnel metrics.

Audit formulas, source data, assumptions, attribution methods, and agency reports for accuracy.

Identify incorrect calculations, inconsistent definitions, unsupported assumptions, and material data gaps.

Translate findings into specific decisions involving budgets, channels, campaigns, offers, creative, landing pages, retention, and resource allocation.

Ensure all material recommendations are financially grounded, traceable to source data, and ready for executive decision-making.



Agency and Channel Management

Manage agencies supporting paid media, lifecycle marketing, SEO/AEO, content, creative, and related functions.

Define agency scopes, KPIs, service-level expectations, reporting requirements, ownership, and escalation paths.

Independently validate agency recommendations and hold partners accountable for results and deadlines.

Address underperformance promptly through documented corrective actions.

Ensure Starbond retains ownership and access to advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Brand, Customer Insight, and Execution

Own customer insight, positioning, messaging architecture, and brand standards.

Govern creative testing, content production, lifecycle campaigns, landing pages, attribution, and conversion optimization.

Ensure campaigns and product launches have clear briefs, readiness checks, QA processes, measurement plans, and post-launch learning reviews.

Remain close enough to execution to inspect work, resolve critical blockers, and improve quality when needed.



Cross-Functional Leadership

Build a consistent planning cadence across Marketing, Product/R&D, Amazon, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Web Development, HR, and the CEO.

Anticipate inventory, capacity, staffing, technical, and operational constraints before they affect launches or marketing commitments.

Surface risks and difficult issues early, supported by evidence, tradeoffs, and a clear recommendation.

Challenge assumptions constructively and redirect resources when customer or financial evidence supports a different decision.



What We’re Looking For

Proven experience leading a DTC or e-commerce Marketing function with accountability for profitable growth.

Strong hands-on knowledge of paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, CRO, content, SEO, and brand strategy.

Advanced understanding of unit economics, including CAC, LTV, CAC payback, MER, gross margin, contribution margin, retention, and cohort analysis.

Ability to independently recreate, audit, and explain marketing calculations using underlying source data.

Experience managing internal Marketing teams and developing accountable leaders.

Strong experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to defined KPIs, deadlines, and commercial expectations.

Ability to connect marketing performance with profitability, customer quality, retention, inventory, and operational capacity.

Experience building processes and systems within a growing or developing Marketing organization.

Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to clearly present evidence, financial impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations.

Willingness to challenge weak assumptions, confront underperformance, and make difficult decisions.

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where strategy and hands-on execution are both required.



Tools and Platforms

Experience with several of the following is expected:

Shopify

Meta Ads Manager

Google Ads

Google Analytics 4

Google Search Console

 and lifecycle marketing platforms

Amazon reporting

Looker, Power BI, or similar business intelligence tools

Google Workspace

ClickUp or similar project-management platforms

Agency reporting and attribution systems



What Success Looks Like

Marketing generates profitable DTC revenue and contribution-margin growth.

CAC and CAC payback remain within approved thresholds by channel, product, and cohort.

At least 90% of committed strategic milestones are delivered or formally replanned.

Agencies consistently meet deadlines and receive timely performance reviews and corrective actions.

Core unit-economics and funnel calculations are accurate, consistent, and traceable to source data.

The Marketing function has clear ownership, capable leaders, reliable reporting, and a scalable operating cadence.

Risks, performance misses, and resource constraints are communicated early with recommended actions.



This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If You

Prefer to operate only as a strategist or advisor.

Depend entirely on analysts, agencies, or dashboards to explain marketing performance.

Present revenue or ROAS as proof of success without considering margin, retention, or customer quality.

Avoid challenging agencies, team members, or leadership when the evidence supports a different decision.

Are uncomfortable entering the details, auditing calculations, or personally unblocking critical work.

Require a fully developed marketing infrastructure before you can perform effectively.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and briefly answer the following questions:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Explain how you calculate CAC, LTV, CAC payback, and contribution margin. Include an example of how these metrics influenced a budget or channel decision.

Share an example of a marketing report, dashboard, or agency recommendation you found to be inaccurate. How did you validate the data, and what did you change?

Describe your experience building or restructuring a Marketing team or operating model.

Share an example of how you held an underperforming agency or team accountable.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, lifecycle marketing, and business intelligence platforms you have used.





We are looking for a Marketing Director who can build the function, develop strong owners, confront difficult issues, and stay close enough to the numbers and execution to drive measurable, profitable growth.

title: Senior Demand & Supply Planner
description:
Who We Are

Starbond is a growing adhesive company committed to excellence, customer centricity, curiosity, humility, and continuous improvement. We sell through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B channels and are strengthening our supply chain planning capabilities to support reliable product availability and scalable growth.



The Role

Starbond is seeking a highly analytical and proactive Senior Demand & Supply Planner to own our end-to-end planning process—from developing a reliable demand forecast to translating it into executable purchasing, materials, production, and distribution plans.



This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical expertise, independent judgment, cross-functional leadership, and ownership. You will challenge assumptions, quantify risks, recommend priorities, and improve planning processes with minimal supervision.



This position requires substantial hands-on experience in BOTH demand planning and supply planning, including BOM explosion and material requirements planning (MRP). If your experience is limited to production planning or scheduling, procurement, or inventory monitoring without ownership of demand forecasts and the resulting supply plans, please do not apply.



We use Cin7, supported by Excel for planning, analysis, validation, and scenario modeling. You must understand the calculations behind system recommendations and be able to independently build, audit, and improve Excel-based planning and MRP models.



Candidates who rely heavily on system-generated outputs and cannot independently perform, explain, and validate planning calculations in Excel will not meet the requirements.



Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning and Forecast Ownership

Own the rolling SKU- and channel-level demand forecast across Amazon, Shopify, and B2B.

Develop forecasts using sales history, seasonality, promotions, customer commitments, product life cycles, channel plans, and future business assumptions.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to gather inputs, challenge assumptions, resolve differences, and establish a documented consensus demand plan.

Separate baseline demand from promotional, event-driven, new-product, and one-time demand.

Track forecast accuracy and bias by SKU and channel, investigate significant variances, and improve forecasting methods.

Maintain documented assumptions, risks, opportunities, scenarios, and forecast version history.

Identify demand changes early and communicate their impact on inventory, purchasing, production, capacity, and cash flow.



Supply and Inventory Planning

Translate the demand forecast into time-phased inventory, purchasing, production, and distribution requirements.

Develop constrained and unconstrained supply plans, identifying supplier, material, capacity, cash, and storage limitations.

Establish and maintain SKU-level reorder points, safety stock, order quantities, and inventory targets.

Apply appropriate safety-stock methods using service-level targets, demand variability, lead-time variability, and supplier reliability.

Monitor stockout risks, excess inventory, slow-moving products, inventory turnover, and service levels.

Recommend prioritized actions that balance product availability, working capital, operating cost, and business risk.

Monitor execution and revise plans as demand, supply, and operating conditions change.



BOM Explosion, Materials, and Production Planning

Perform BOM explosion to translate finished-goods requirements into raw-material, component, and packaging requirements.

Calculate time-phased net material requirements, accounting for available inventory, open orders, lead times, minimum order quantities, yields, and scrap.

Determine what needs to be purchased or produced, in what quantities, and when.

Validate BOM accuracy and identify missing, outdated, or inconsistent planning inputs.

Translate demand and material availability into feasible production plans and schedules.

Identify material shortages, capacity conflicts, and timing risks early and recommend practical solutions.

Coordinate with Procurement, Operations, suppliers, and warehouse partners to align purchasing, materials, and production plans.



Cin7, Excel, and Planning Tool Development

Own and improve planning workflows using Cin7 and supporting Excel-based tools.

Maintain and validate planning inputs, including SKU records, forecasts, BOMs, inventory balances, open purchase orders, supplier lead times, and production requirements.

Independently build, audit, and improve Excel-based forecasting, replenishment, and MRP models, including building models from the ground up when needed.

Connect demand forecasts, BOMs, inventory, open orders, lead times, and production requirements into reliable planning calculations.

Validate system-generated recommendations against underlying data and planning logic.

Build formulas, data-validation controls, exception flags, dashboards, and scenario models that are accurate and easy to maintain.

Investigate discrepancies, broken links, duplicated records, manual work, and weak assumptions.

Recommend practical improvements to data quality, system workflows, and automation.

Document planning logic, data sources, ownership, update frequency, and standard operating procedures.



Supply Risk and Scenario Planning

Evaluate supplier performance, including actual versus quoted lead times, delivery reliability, quality issues, and supply variability.

Quantify supply risks and recommend safety-stock adjustments, changes to order timing, or alternative sourcing options.

Develop scenarios for demand changes, supplier delays, promotions, new-product launches, and capacity limitations.

Present alternatives with clear implications for customer service, inventory, cost, and cash flow.

Escalate critical risks promptly with recommended actions, responsible owners, and deadlines.



S&OP and Cross-Functional Leadership

Drive a structured monthly S&OP planning cycle connecting demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and financial considerations.

Lead planning discussions and constructively challenge unsupported assumptions.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Operations, and leadership to reconcile demand with supply capabilities and business priorities.

Present concise updates explaining planning gaps, business impact, tradeoffs, and decisions required.

Document agreed decisions and ensure changes flow into forecasts, supply plans, purchasing plans, and production schedules.

Establish clear planning responsibilities and follow through on agreed actions.

Communicate proactively when information is incomplete, assumptions change, or execution is at risk.





Required Qualifications

At least seven years of relevant planning experience, including a minimum of five years of direct, hands-on responsibility spanning both demand planning and supply planning.

Demonstrated ownership of a rolling SKU-level demand forecast and responsibility for translating it into an executable supply plan.

Strong understanding of forecasting methods, seasonality, promotions, forecast accuracy, forecast bias, consensus planning, and scenario analysis.

Practical experience performing BOM explosion, net material requirements calculations, and raw-material or component planning.

Strong knowledge of reorder-point logic, safety-stock modeling, service levels, lead-time variability, and inventory optimization.

Experience translating forecasts into purchasing and production requirements.

Demonstrated ability to build or substantially redesign an Excel-based MRP, inventory-planning, or replenishment model.

Advanced Excel proficiency, including structured tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, PivotTables, conditional logic, data validation, error controls, and scenario modeling.

Ability to independently calculate, explain, and validate planning requirements without relying solely on ERP/MRP outputs.

Hands-on experience using an ERP or MRP system for inventory, materials, and production planning. Cin7 experience is strongly preferred.

Proven ability to diagnose planning problems, improve processes, and make sound recommendations with incomplete information.

Ability to influence stakeholders, resolve conflicting priorities, and challenge assumptions respectfully.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong ownership, emotional intelligence, attention to detail, and proactive communication.

Availability to work a full eight-hour shift aligned with Pacific Time business hours.

Hands-on experience creating Amazon A+ Content is required.



The successful candidate must be able to establish creative direction, develop clear visual standards, manage team performance, and personally produce high-quality design work. You should understand how visual communication supports marketing goals and know how to use AI and modern creative tools to improve production efficiency while maintaining strong creative judgment.

At least 10 years of professional graphic design experience, with substantial work supporting marketing, e-commerce, retail, or consumer-product brands.

Creative Direction and Brand Management

Develop, document, maintain, and enforce comprehensive brand guidelines and visual standards.

Translate business and marketing objectives into clear, effective creative concepts.

Website and landing-page graphics

Introduce practical uses of AI-assisted tools, automation, templates, and reusable design systems.
