title: Payments Reconciliation Lead
description:
Payments Reconciliation Lead - Contract



Job Description

WHO WE ARE

Customer is the most valued partner for K–12 schools to build trust, strengthen community, and grow enrollment. Ranked among the best EdTech Companies in America, Customer supports more than 7,000 schools and districts worldwide with an integrated platform for websites, communications, mobile apps, enrollment, and marketing services.

Headquartered in Glastonbury, Connecticut, Customer is a global company with employees working remotely across nearly every U.S. state, as well as throughout Europe, South America, and Asia.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, connected, and empowered to grow. That’s why we invest in our employees through competitive benefits, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative culture built on partnership and purpose. Whether you’re looking to expand your skills, take on new challenges, or make a meaningful impact in education, Customer offers the opportunity to grow your career while helping schools thrive.

At Customer, every interaction matters — with our clients, with each other, and with the schools and families we serve. Join us and help shape stronger school communities around the world



SUMMARY

Customer gives K-12 schools and districts one connected suite for their websites, communications, enrollment and payments, used by about 7,000 districts and schools. Payments is the part of that suite that ties the others together: a family that gets a message from the school, enrolls a student and pays a fee should see one experience, and the district's finance office should see one clean set of books. We are building a reconciliation service to support our largest district clients as that suite comes together, and we are looking for a Payments Reconciliation Lead to build it and run it. You will set up the procedures, hire and train a small team, and be the person who makes sure a district's numbers tie every day. You report to the Sr. Accounting Manager and work daily with Customer Success, who own the client relationship, and with Product. This is a contract-to-hire role.



RESPONSIBILITIES

•  Runbooks: Turn each district's reconciliation workflow, from the first chargeback notice to the final tie-out against settlement, into written procedures with quality checks.

•  Team: Hire and train 5 to 10 reconciliation specialists through a staffing partner or an offshore vendor.

•  Daily Tracking: Run a daily tracker of which task, which client, who did it and who reviewed it.

•  Quality Review: Review every file before it goes out. Nothing reaches a district unchecked.

•  Client Reporting: Send a weekly status to each client's Customer Success Manager, who owns the client conversation. Make sure they walk in with the facts.

•  Chargeback Notices: Own the handoff from Operations so each district gets a complete notice with the order and transaction detail attached, instead of a screenshot in an
.

•  Line-Item Reconstruction: Locate each affected order in the Web Store portal, rebuild it at the line-item level with the account or GL code from Inventory, the payment ID, the dollar amount and the sales tax, and lay it out the same way as the district's settlement file.

•  Fix Files: Produce the ERP-ready correction file, broken into the right accounting lines with sales tax, in the district's import format (Munis, for example), and confirm it posted.

•  Settlement Tie-Out: Reconcile the individual orders and the fix-file detail back to the single aggregated chargeback deduction on the settlement statement.

•  Related Notices: Extend the same approach to delayed or unfunded transactions and to disputes and NSF returns, so districts get one daily file instead of one
 at a time.

•  Automation Input: Keep a ranked list of what is slow and which report fields would remove each step, and hand it to Product and Engineering.

•  Capacity and Cost: Track hours per client per workflow, build the capacity model for the full client list, and recommend US temps versus offshore from real error and turnaround data.

•  Performance Measures: Same-day task completion, files out by the agreed cutoff, business days from chargeback notice to ERP-ready file, disputes surfaced within one business day, fix files that tie with no rework, and automation requests accepted by engineering.



QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

•  5+ years in accounting operations, treasury, payments or merchant services, with bank or settlement reconciliation as your own daily work, not something you reviewed from above.

•  2+ years leading, training or supervising a reconciliation or back-office team. Temp or offshore staff is a plus.

•  Experience writing procedures and quality checks that other people followed.

•  Working knowledge of the card dispute and chargeback process from the merchant side, including evidence deadlines.

•  Experience producing or validating ERP import files. Munis is a plus.

•  Advanced Excel: lookups, SUMIFS, pivots, large CSV cleanup.

•  Ability to explain a reconciliation break to someone who is not an accountant.

•  CPA, CMA or an accounting degree is a plus.

•  Payment processor, payment facilitator or bank operations background is a plus.

•  K-12 or public sector fund accounting is a plus.

•  Experience managing a staffing partner or an offshore vendor is a plus.

•  Experience handing a manual process to a product team to automate is a plus.

title: Powerpoint-to-Video Project
description:
PowerPoint Designer / Video Editor – Turn Existing Presentation Into Professional Vide



We are looking for an experienced PowerPoint designer to take an existing presentation and turn it into a polished, professional presentation that can also be exported as an MP4 video.



The PowerPoint is already substantially built and contains much of the content, photos, and information needed. This is **not a presentation that needs to be created from scratch.**



### Scope of Work



You will:



- Review and improve the existing PowerPoint presentation

- Clean up slide layouts, typography, spacing, alignment, and overall design

- Create a consistent and professional visual style throughout the presentation

- Improve the presentation of photos and project examples

- Add tasteful animations to text, photos, graphics, and other elements where appropriate

- Add professional slide transitions

- Ensure animations and transitions work properly when the presentation is exported to video

- Prepare the presentation for slide-by-slide narration

- Add and synchronize narration/audio provided by the client

- Adjust slide and animation timing to match the narration

- Export the completed presentation as a high-quality MP4 video

- Deliver the final editable PowerPoint file so the client can update the presentation in the future



### Final Deliverables



1. Final polished and fully editable `.PPTX` PowerPoint file

2. PowerPoint with animations, transitions, narration, and timing properly configured

3. Final high-quality `.MP4` video

4. All editable/source assets used in the project, if applicable

5. Up to **3 rounds of revisions**



### What We're Looking For



You should have strong experience with:



- Microsoft PowerPoint

- PowerPoint animations and transitions

- Presentation design

- Audio/narration synchronization

- PowerPoint-to-video/MP4 exporting

- Creating professional corporate or nonprofit presentations



The finished presentation should feel polished and engaging, but **not overly flashy or over-animated**. We want clean, professional motion that enhances the presentation rather than distracting from the content.



### Important



The client needs to be able to update the PowerPoint later, so everything should remain as editable as possible. Please do not build the project in After Effects or another video program in a way that makes future PowerPoint editing difficult.



When applying, please include:



- Examples of PowerPoint presentations you have designed

- Examples involving PowerPoint animation, if available

- Confirmation that you can create an editable PowerPoint that can be exported into an MP4 with narration

- Your estimated turnaround time



**Fixed project budget: $200 USD**

About the Role



We are seeking a forward-thinking and innovative SEO Specialist with specialized expertise in AI search optimization and AI chat bot ecosystems. As search behavior rapidly shifts toward LLM-powered search engines, AI assistants, and conversational interfaces, you will lead our strategy to ensure our brand remains visible, authoritative, and recommended across both traditional search engines and AI-driven conversational platforms.



The ideal candidate combines deep technical SEO expertise with cutting-edge knowledge of how large language models (LLMs), AI chat bots, and generative search tools discover, index, and rank content.

AI & Conversational Search Strategy: Develop and execute organic growth strategies tailored to AI-powered search engines (e.g., ChatGPT search, Google Gemini, Perplexity) and AI chat bot recommendations.

Content Collaboration & AI Alignment: Partner with copywriters and content teams to craft authoritative, context-rich content designed to answer complex multi-turn queries handled by AI chat bots.

Performance Tracking & Analytics: Monitor organic performance, referral traffic from AI platforms, and brand mention frequency across emerging generative search tools and chat interfaces.

Trend Monitoring: Stay ahead of evolving algorithms across major LLMs, search engine generative experiences (SGE), and conversational search integrations.

Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: [X]+ years of proven experience in SEO, with a dedicated focus or demonstrable track record in AI search optimization, LLMs, or conversational search.

Technical Expertise: Advanced understanding of technical SEO, schema markup, entity optimization, and how generative AI models retrieve and synthesize web content.

Tool Proficiency: Familiarity with modern SEO suites (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog) alongside experience tracking visibility across AI search engines and chat platforms.

Analytical Mindset: Strong data-driven background in interpreting search console metrics, user intent, and traffic shifts resulting from AI-driven search changes.

Communication: Excellent ability to translate complex technical and AI search dynamics into clear strategies for cross-functional teams.

Nebula Genomics makes whole-genome sequencing accessible directly to consumers. We increasingly use AI-assisted development tools and MCPs throughout our engineering workflow.

Required

title: HIRING: IT Manager Technology Delivery and Business Systems
description:
Important Notice to Applicants:



Please note that we are only contacting and communicating with candidates through OnlineJobsPH. Any applications or direct contact made outside of these channels, including
s, social media messages, direct messages to our CEO, or messages sent to our general company
, will not be considered and will be automatically declined.



About the Company:



We are a private U.S.-based company operating across multiple departments that support legal, staffing, and client-service operations. Our teams collaborate in dynamic, fast-paced environments focused on innovation, integrity, and client success.



In this role, you’ll work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams, making a real impact in operational, legal, and client-focused projects—all from the comfort of your home. Details about our company structure and associated teams will be introduced during the interview process





About the Role



We build and operate the technology behind a client intake and conversion platform for law firms, where our intake teams are supported by AI and automation. The environment includes custom software, AI agents, integrations, Salesforce, contact-center systems, and corporate infrastructure.



We are hiring an IT Manager to lead day-to-day technology delivery and operations, manage a multidisciplinary team, maintain portfolio visibility, lead stakeholder discovery and requirements gathering, and serve as the primary technology partner for other departments. Direct reports currently include a Senior Voice AI Engineer, Senior Integrations and Platform Engineer, Network Administrator, Contact Center Administrator for RingCentral, Salesforce Administrator, and two Salesforce Developers. The team will grow with the business. The current IT Manager is moving into a new role within the company and will work alongside you through the end of the year to ensure a smooth transition.



Reporting to the Technology Director, you will turn company priorities into coordinated execution, resolve routine decisions independently, and escalate matters requiring strategic direction, architecture review, material investment, risk acceptance, or confirmation of requirements. The role requires people leadership, disciplined delivery management, business analysis, and technical fluency across engineering, AI, integrations, Salesforce, contact-center systems, networking, security, and cloud.



What You Will Own



Team Leadership

Manage, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of engineers, developers, and administrators.

Set clear expectations, priorities, and success measures, and run consistent one-on-ones, performance reviews, and career development.

Balance project work, operations, support, and technical debt, and reduce single points of failure through cross-training and documentation.

Technology Portfolio and Project Delivery

Maintain a current view of all technology projects, requests, dependencies, risks, and commitments.

Establish practical intake and prioritization with the Technology Director and department leaders.

Translate approved priorities into charters, milestones, owners, resource plans, and success criteria, and maintain an integrated roadmap and portfolio dashboard.

Apply Agile, Kanban, or hybrid practices as the work requires, and ensure releases include testing, user acceptance, training, rollback planning, and post-launch support.

Stakeholder Partnership, Requirements Gathering, and Prioritization

Serve as the primary technology point of contact for leaders across departments, leading discovery sessions and stakeholder interviews to distinguish the underlying business need from the initial solution request.

Map current processes and translate needs into requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria confirmed with business owners before development begins, and coordinate user acceptance testing.

Evaluate new requests transparently against business value, urgency, risk, effort, and strategic alignment, and work with the Technology Director to resolve competing priorities and make capacity tradeoffs visible.

Systems Oversight and Partnership with the Technology Director

Oversee the coordinated health of Salesforce, RingCentral, network infrastructure, custom applications, AI services, and integrations, ensuring system owners maintain monitoring, documentation, backups, access controls, and recovery plans.

Partner with the Technology Director on security, change management, and business continuity; manage vendors, renewals, and budget input as assigned.

Own day-to-day team management, project coordination, requirements, and delivery execution, keeping the Technology Director informed through concise portfolio reporting and early notice of material risks.

Escalate decisions affecting architecture, security, budget, vendors, staffing, scope, or unresolved requirements with context, options, and a recommendation, then execute approved decisions. Escalation does not transfer ownership.



First 90 Days

Days 1 to 30: Meet the team and key stakeholders, learn the systems and priorities, inventory active and proposed work with owners and risks, and align with the Technology Director on decision rights and escalation thresholds.

Days 31 to 60: Implement consistent intake, requirements, prioritization, and reporting; organize roadmaps and backlogs; set ownership and milestones for top initiatives; and create a capacity view leadership can trust.

Days 61 to 90: Operate a reliable delivery cadence, advance priority initiatives, set development goals with each team member, and present roadmap, staffing, and risk recommendations.



Required Experience

7+ years across IT, business systems, software delivery, technical project management, or business analysis, including at least 3 years directly managing technical employees.

Proven delivery of multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities, cross-team dependencies, and senior stakeholders.

Strong project management (scope, schedule, resources, risk, budget, release readiness) and business analysis (discovery, process mapping, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user acceptance testing).

Technical fluency across SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations, software development, cloud, networking, security, and production operations.

Sound judgment on when to d
, confirm, or escalate, plus strong written communication, facilitation, and coaching, with a practical, low-ego leadership style.



Preferred Experience

Leading Salesforce administrators and developers, including Flow, Apex, integrations, environments, and release management.

RingCentral or another contact-center platform, call routing, or contact-center reporting.

Legal technology, professional services, or another regulated, privacy-sensitive environment.

Jira, Asana, or Azure DevOps; vendor and SOW management; PMP, CSM, ITIL, CBAP, or Salesforce certifications.

You need not be the deepest expert in every system, but must be fluent enough to ask strong questions, evaluate risk, and know when deeper review is required. No specific degree is required.



What Success Looks Like

Leadership has a reliable, current view of every material technology initiative.

Requests are prioritized consistently, requirements are confirmed before development begins, and projects have realistic plans and accountable owners.

Delivery becomes more predictable, and the Technology Director can focus on strategy and architecture without losing visibility into execution.

title: Business Development Manager & Booking Agent
description:
# Job Description: Business Development Manager & Booking Agent

**Company:** iModel Miami  

**Department:** Business Development & Talent Bookings  

**Location:** Miami, Florida  

**Employment Type:** [Full-Time / Part-Time / Contract]



## About iModel Miami

iModel Miami is a modeling and talent development business focused on connecting models with modeling agencies, mother agencies, casting professionals, brands, and industry opportunities. We aim to build a strong professional network, develop talent relationships, and create opportunities for models to advance their careers.



## Position Overview

iModel Miami is seeking a motivated, organized, and results-driven **Business Development Manager & Booking Agent** to expand our agency network, generate new business opportunities, facilitate model submissions, and coordinate bookings.



This position combines sales, relationship management, talent coordination, and administrative responsibilities. The ideal candidate is a proactive self-starter who can identify opportunities, initiate professional conversations, maintain consistent follow-up, and turn prospective relationships into measurable business results.



The successful candidate must be comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities, and meeting performance targets.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Business Development & Sales

- Identify and establish relationships with domestic and international modeling agencies, mother agencies, casting directors, brands, photographers, and other industry professionals.

- Research prospective partners and decision-makers to develop a qualified business development pipeline.

- Conduct daily outreach through
, telephone, social media, and other approved communication channels.

- Introduce iModel Miami's services, communicate partnership opportunities, and schedule meetings with prospective partners.

- Follow up consistently with prospects to develop relationships and secure collaborations.

- Identify potential revenue opportunities and support the negotiation and development of business agreements within approved terms.

- Maintain a pipeline of prospects, meetings, partnership opportunities, and business development outcomes.



### 2. Model Submissions & Talent Representation

- Identify appropriate opportunities for models based on their portfolios, experience, availability, and professional objectives.

- Prepare and submit model profiles, portfolios, digitals, measurements, and other requested materials accurately.

- Match suitable talent with agency requests, casting opportunities, clients, and prospective partners.

- Maintain accurate records of model submissions, responses, opportunities, and next steps.

- Communicate professionally with models and agency representatives throughout the submission process.

- Protect model privacy and represent talent honestly and professionally.



### 3. Booking & Scheduling Coordination

- Coordinate booking inquiries between models, agencies, and clients.

- Confirm model availability, rates, dates, locations, requirements, and other booking details before finalizing arrangements.

- Schedule meetings, castings, callbacks, and booking-related appointments.

- Track confirmations, outstanding responses, deadlines, and changes to booking arrangements.

- Communicate schedule changes promptly and help resolve conflicts professionally.

- Ensure bookings are not represented as confirmed until the required parties have approved the terms.



### 4. Relationship Management

- Develop and maintain long-term professional relationships with agency contacts, clients, models, and industry partners.

- Maintain a professional, responsive, and organized communication style.

- Follow up after meetings, submissions, castings, and completed bookings.

- Identify opportunities to strengthen existing relationships and generate repeat business.

- Maintain accurate contact information and interaction histories in the company's designated CRM or database.



### 5. Reporting & Accountability

- Maintain accurate records of outreach, conversations, meetings, submissions, follow-ups, and booking activity.

- Submit daily end-of-day reports detailing completed tasks, measurable results, pending opportunities, and next-day priorities.

- Track business development performance against assigned targets.

- Maintain an organized follow-up calendar and ensure deadlines are met.

- Communicate obstacles, client concerns, and urgent booking issues to management.

- Participate in team meetings and provide updates on pipeline development and partnership progress.



## Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated using measurable results, work quality, reliability, and consistency.



Key performance indicators may include:

- Number of qualified agency and client prospects identified.

- Daily outreach activity and meaningful conversations with decision-makers.

- Meetings scheduled with prospective agencies and partners.

- New professional relationships established.

- Model submissions completed accurately and on time.

- Booking inquiries, confirmed bookings, and revenue opportunities generated.

- Follow-up completion rate and CRM accuracy.

- Timeliness and completeness of daily reports.

- Professionalism, responsiveness, and adherence to company procedures.



Specific numerical targets will be established by management based on the company's current business needs and the employee's assigned responsibilities.



## Qualifications

- Experience in business development, sales, talent management, booking coordination, recruiting, public relations, or a related field is preferred.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Demonstrated ability to conduct professional outreach and follow up with prospective clients or partners.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple contacts, deadlines, and scheduling requirements.

- Comfortable using
, spreadsheets, calendars, CRM systems, and online research tools.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and remain accountable for assigned results.

- Professional judgment when handling confidential information and representing talent.

- Willingness to learn modeling industry practices, agency expectations, and talent submission procedures.



Previous modeling-industry experience is beneficial but not required for candidates who demonstrate strong sales, communication, organization, and relationship-building skills.



## Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is:

- **Proactive:** Takes initiative instead of waiting for instructions.

- **Results-oriented:** Focuses on generating opportunities and measurable outcomes.

- **Persistent:** Follows up professionally without neglecting prospects.

- **Organized:** Keeps accurate records and manages deadlines consistently.

- **Professional:** Communicates effectively with clients, agencies, and talent.

- **Accountable:** Completes assigned tasks and reports results honestly.

- **Resourceful:** Finds new agencies, opportunities, and potential business partners.

- **Ethical:** Represents models and the company accurately and responsibly.



## Compensation

Compensation will be determined based on experience, employment classification, and the agreed compensation structure. Any base pay, commission, bonuses, or performance incentives will be outlined separately in the offer or applicable written agreement.



## How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their résumé and a brief explanation of their relevant experience in sales, business development, booking coordination, talent management, or professional relationship development.



Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a skills assessment, participate in an AI-assisted interview, and complete a practical business development assignment.



**iModel Miami is seeking a professional who can build relationships, generate opportunities, coordinate bookings, and contribute directly to the company's growth.**

title: Experienced Bookkeeper | US Business Books, Reconciliation & Month-End Close
description:
MYAMZTEAM is hiring an experienced Bookkeeper to own accurate day-to-day records, reconciliations, and a dependable month-end close.



We are a US-based Amazon and marketplace agency. We need someone who can investigate discrepancies, keep supporting documentation organized, and give leadership a clear picture of the numbers. You should be comfortable taking ownership and explaining what needs attention.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Maintain accurate transaction records and a consistent chart of accounts.

- Reconcile bank, credit card, and payment processor accounts to source statements.

- Track accounts receivable and accounts payable, prepare aging reports, and flag overdue or unusual items.

- Review invoices, receipts, reimbursements, and recurring expenses for completeness and proper classification.

- Identify duplicate entries, missing transactions, misclassifications, and unexplained differences; document and resolve them with approval where required.

- Own a documented month-end checklist and prepare accurate profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash reporting with supporting schedules.

- Explain material changes and unresolved issues in concise, plain English.

- Keep each legal entity's books, accounts, source documents, and reports separate. Document any approved intercompany activity clearly.

- Coordinate with leadership and the external accountant on adjustments and year-end support.

- Improve repeatable processes while preserving approval controls and a clear audit trail.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on bookkeeping experience for US businesses, including reconciliations and month-end close.

- Strong double-entry accounting fundamentals and practical understanding of the balance sheet and profit and loss statement.

- Proficiency in an established accounting platform. Specify your experience with QuickBooks Online, Xero, or other systems and which tasks you personally owned.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliation schedules.

- Ability to investigate differences rather than force a reconciliation or guess at classifications.

- Clear English communication, reliable follow-through, and careful handling of confidential records.



VALUABLE ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE

Agency or professional services bookkeeping, multiple legal entities, e-commerce/marketplace settlement reconciliation, merchant fees, refunds, and inventory/COGS accounting. Relevant certifications are welcome, but demonstrated accuracy and judgment matter most.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Reconciliations are supported and current. Month-end reports tie to the underlying records. Open issues have clear explanations and next steps. Leadership knows what requires a decision. Separate entities remain separate.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT

Remote, Philippines. We are seeking an ongoing team relationship. Compensation, weekly hours, and US Eastern Time overlap will be agreed based on experience and workload. Include your expected USD rate, preferred weekly hours, earliest start date, and available overlap.



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject: MYAMZ-BOOKKEEPER | Your Name

Please include:

1. Your resume and a brief description of the businesses you have supported.

2. The accounting systems you use, typical monthly transaction volume, and the parts of bookkeeping and month-end close you personally own.

3. A concise example of a reconciliation problem you found, how you investigated it, and how you verified the correction.

4. Your month-end close checklist in 6-10 bullets.

5. Your response to this scenario in
words: A bank deposit is lower than the related sales report, an invoice appears twice, and a transaction may belong to another legal entity. What would you review, what would you avoid assuming, and what would you escalate before making changes?

6. Your expected rate, availability, start date, and current commitments affecting your schedule.



Please do not send confidential client financial records. Use anonymized examples or a sample you created.



SELECTION PROCESS

THE PROCESS

PAY

$7/hour USD, about 56 hours per week (about $392/week). Paid weekly via Wise.

title: Platform & Integrations Engineer (operations)
description:
Platform & Integrations Engineer

Romea.AI · Philippines-based team, remote · Full-time · You work directly with the founder



What we are building

AI front-office staff for plastic surgery and aesthetic practices in the US and Australia. Our AI talks to patients over SMS, web chat, iMessage and voice, qualifies them, books them into the practice's EMR and calendar, follows up, takes payments, and hands the practice an analytics portal that shows the whole funnel from ad to surgery. Around fifteen practices run on it today and they talk to it more than they talk to their own front desk. Nobody has done this properly for this industry yet. We are small, fast and profitable enough to be picky.



Who we are looking for

An engineer who gets a kick out of two things at once: watching an AI agent book a real surgery consult at 3 am for a clinic in Texas, and knowing exactly why it worked, because you run the system it ran on.

You are an AI fanatic in the practical sense. You use coding agents every day, you have opinions about which models are worth their price for which job, and you have learned the hard way where they lie. You also like servers. Backups you have actually restored, a Caddyfile you wrote by hand, a Postgres you tuned, a Cloudflare worker you fixed at midnight. If one of those two halves bores you, this is not your job.



What you will do

Run production. Two droplets, a Cloudflare account, a handful of Python services, Postgres with pgvector, the databases, the backups, the secrets, the deploys. It is yours. You d
 how it is monitored and what "healthy" means.

Build with AI, ship as a human. Code gets written with Claude Code and our own agent setup on the build server. You are the gate: you review it, test it, deploy it from a git tag and you own what is live.

Onboard practices and build integrations. New clients go live as configuration on one shared engine, not as forks. When a practice needs its EMR (4D, Symplast, Nextech, PatientNow), its CRM (GoHighLevel), a payment provider or a new channel wired in, you write the adapter, with tests.

Talk to clients. Practice owners and coordinators know you by name. You join the onboarding call, you explain what the AI will and will not do, you fix what they report and you tell them when it is fixed. Customer success handles the day to day; the technical conversations are yours.

D
 with us. Four people, no layers. Model choice, what to build next, which client request becomes a product feature, how we handle an i
: you are in the room and your vote counts. The founder designs the system plans and directs the AI builders; you make sure what comes out is real, safe and running, and you push back when a plan is wrong.

Keep it clean. Patient data, HIPAA, consent, money. No shortcuts, no PHI in repos or chat, least privilege, audit trails where it matters.



What you bring

Five or more years of running systems you were on call for, including at least one migration you finished and one i
 you traced across several services.

Python at a professional level (FastAPI, async, pytest). TypeScript well enough to read and patch a Cloudflare worker.

Postgres beyond the basics (partitions, roles, pooling, pgvector, backups and restores), Linux, Docker, Caddy or nginx, systemd, Cloudflare Workers, D1 and Queues.

Real-world API work: OAuth2, webhooks, idempotency, retries, rate limits. GoHighLevel, EMR or healthcare APIs are a plus.

Daily use of AI coding agents, and the judgement to know when their output is wrong.

Comfortable on a call with a surgeon's office manager. Clear written English.



What this is not

We have an architecture and we are not rewriting it. If your instinct on day one is a new framework, a new language or a platform v2, we will disagree. The interesting problems here are in making a live AI system reliable, extending it one integration at a time, and shipping every week.

A conversation with the founder, then three practical exercises of about an hour each, with whatever tools you normally use, AI agents included. We look at the result and how you explain it.

A Cloudflare worker, a tenant row in the database, and a patient message that never got a reply. Find out why.

A Python CRM adapter that double-books an appointment on retry. Fix it and add the test that would have caught it.

The exercises run on our real gateway code, our real adapter test harness and a throwaway server we give you. Then a last call where you tell us what you would change in the first month.

Terms

Freelance contract, 40 hours per week. I
 work outside your hours is paid.



Start ASAP



How to apply

Write to 
 with three things: an i
 you resolved and what you changed afterwards, a migration you finished and how long it took, and something you built with AI that you are proud of. CV optional.

title: Digital Marketing & Local SEO Specialist – Google Business Profile, SEO & Website
description:

Remote | Philippines | Part-Time 15–25 Hours/Week | Long-Term

We want someone who understands:

4. AI Search Optimization / GEO / AEO



Traditional Google search is no longer the only way customers discover businesses.



We also want Hunt Glass to become increasingly visible when consumers use AI-powered search and recommendation tools to d
 which local businesses to use.



Experience with AI Search Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and/or Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) is a major plus.



We want someone who is interested in helping Hunt Glass become a business that AI systems can easily:



Discover → Understand → Trust → Accurately Represent → Recommend when relevant

- Creating useful, authoritative content that directly answers customer questions

- Improving website structure and machine-readable information

- Structured data/schema implementation

- Maintaining accurate and consistent business information across reputable online sources

- Building legitimate local citations

- Building brand authority

- Digital PR and outreach

- Earning relevant third-party mentions

- Earning legitimate backlinks

- Developing content that can serve as a useful source for search engines and AI systems

- Monitoring how Hunt Glass appears in AI-generated answers

- Testing searches and prompts relevant to our customers

- Researching how competitors appear in AI search

- Identifying sources that AI systems rely upon in our industry and local markets

- Tracking changes in AI-powered search

- Testing strategies and measuring results



We understand that AI search optimization is a rapidly developing field.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply added "GEO" or "AI SEO" to their résumé because it is a popular new term.



We want someone who understands the underlying principles of authority, relevance, structured information, reputation, useful content, third-party validation, and brand visibility—and who actively studies how AI is changing customer discovery.



5. Online Authority, Mentions & Digital PR



We don't want Hunt Glass's online presence to consist only of Hunt Glass talking about itself.



As we grow, we want to build legitimate authority across the internet.



You may help identify opportunities for:



- Relevant business directories

- Local citations

- Industry websites

- Business partnerships

- Community partnerships

- Local media coverage

- Digital PR

- Partner website mentions

- Guest contributions

- Legitimate backlinks

- Other reputable third-party references to Hunt Glass



Our goal is to build a strong online brand that both people and search technologies have good reason to trust.

You should be comfortable helping us track:



- Website traffic

- Organic search traffic

- Google Business Profile activity

- Phone calls

- Quote requests

- Form submissions

- Leads

- Scheduled jobs

- Conversion rates

- Advertising leads

- Cost per lead

- Cost per acquired customer

- Search rankings

- Local rankings

- AI-search visibility where reasonably measurable



Ultimately, we want to understand:



Marketing Source → Lead → Scheduled Job → Revenue



We want decisions based on data rather than guesses.

Experience with Google Ads is a plus, but you do not need to be our primary Google Ads expert.



We may use a specialized Google Ads professional for higher-level PPC strategy.



You may work with our advertising and social-media team on:



- Landing pages

- Conversion tracking

- Analytics

- Website changes

- Keyword research

- Reporting

- SEO/PPC coordination



Experience with Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising is also a plus.

We want someone who knows how to use modern AI tools to accomplish significantly more without sacrificing quality.

- Competitor research

- Content planning

Exceptional at

Still learning

title: AI Automation & Agent Development Specialist
description:
Job Title: AI Automation & Agent Development Specialist



Company: Spectrum Florida Inc. — Umbrella of Companies

Department: Technology, Systems & Business Operations

Employment Type: Full-Time or Contract (Based on Experience)

Location: To Be Determined



Position Overview



Spectrum Florida Inc. is seeking a highly motivated AI Automation & Agent Development Specialist to evaluate, redesign, and automate business processes across our portfolio of companies. The ideal candidate has experience in software development, AI agent creation, API integrations, and workflow automation, with a strong preference for candidates who have built functional AI agents or business applications.



This position will work directly with company management and department personnel to understand how each business operates, identify repetitive or inefficient tasks, document existing procedures, and develop AI-powered systems using Claude by Anthropic and other appropriate technologies.



Our goal is to build intelligent AI agents capable of managing and executing business workflows across sales, customer service, recruiting, scheduling, dispatch, operations, reporting, and administrative functions—with minimal manual intervention.



We are looking for someone who can do more than recommend automation tools. You must be able to analyze a process, design a solution, build it, connect it to the necessary software, test it, and implement a reliable system that produces measurable results.



Key Responsibilities



1. Business Process Analysis



Work directly with management and employees to understand existing company workflows.



Review how tasks are completed from beginning to end across each department.



Interview employees, review SOPs, observe daily operations, and identify bottlenecks.



Document current processes, decision points, exceptions, and required approvals.



Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual work and reduce operational costs.



Create process maps and automation implementation plans for each department.



2. AI Agent Development



Design, develop, and deploy AI agents using Claude API, Claude Agent SDK, or other appropriate agent-building technologies.



Build agents that can interpret instructions, make decisions within defined permissions, execute tasks, and communicate with other systems.



Develop specialized agents for sales, recruiting, customer support, scheduling, dispatch, operations, and administration.



Create reusable agent skills, prompts, tools, and workflows for recurring business processes.



Implement error handling, task verification, logging, escalation procedures, and recovery mechanisms.



Optimize agent performance, reliability, and AI usage costs.



3. Software Development & API Integrations



Connect AI agents to existing company software through APIs, webhooks, and approved integrations.



Develop custom applications, internal dashboards, databases, and administrative tools as needed.



Integrate platforms such as Gmail, Google Workspace, Google Sheets, QuickBooks, Connecteam, CRM systems, and other business applications.



Build automated workflows that transfer information between systems without unnecessary manual data entry.



Develop backend logic, database structures, authentication, and permission controls.



Use tools such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, SQL, Git, and automation platforms where appropriate.



4. End-to-End Business Automation



Evaluate entire workflows rather than automating isolated tasks.



Build systems that can receive information, validate data, perform the next required actions, update records, notify relevant personnel, and track completion.



Automate tasks such as lead intake, proposal preparation, customer follow-ups, candidate screening, employee onboarding, payroll preparation, operational reporting, and compliance tracking.



Establish human approval checkpoints for financial transactions, contractual commitments, sensitive employee matters, and other high-impact decisions.



Monitor automated workflows to identify failures, incomplete tasks, and opportunities for improvement.



5. Testing, Documentation & Continuous Improvement



Test AI agents against real-world scenarios and exceptions before deployment.



Develop SOPs, technical documentation, workflow diagrams, and employee training materials.



Establish KPIs to measure automation success, accuracy, processing time, cost savings, and reliability.



Maintain and improve deployed systems as company needs change.



Train employees to use the new systems and provide ongoing technical support.



Required Qualifications



Demonstrated experience in software development, workflow automation, AI systems, or a related technical field.



Understanding of APIs, webhooks, authentication, and integrations between software platforms.



Ability to analyze complex business processes and translate them into technical workflows.



Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.



Ability to work independently, troubleshoot errors, and take projects from concept through implementation.



Understanding of data security, access controls, and responsible handling of confidential business information.



Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications



Candidates with experience in any of the following will receive priority consideration:



Building AI agents with Claude API, Claude Agent SDK, or comparable agent frameworks.



Developing autonomous or semi-autonomous AI systems that use tools to complete multi-step tasks.



Creating custom software applications, internal business platforms, or administrative dashboards.



Integrating Gmail, Google Workspace, QuickBooks, Connecteam, CRMs, and other operational software.



Programming in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages.



Working with SQL databases, cloud infrastructure, Git, and deployment pipelines.



Using n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.



Implementing AI tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agent memory where appropriate.



Building reliable production systems with logging, monitoring, retries, and human-in-the-loop approvals.



Experience automating multiple departments or entire businesses.



A computer science degree is not required if you can demonstrate strong technical ability and provide examples of working applications, integrations, or AI agents you have built.



First 90-Day Objectives



Days 1–30: Audit & Design



Review company operations and interview key personnel.



Document current workflows and identify high-value automation opportunities.



Prioritize projects by feasibility, cost, risk, and expected return.



Present an implementation roadmap and initial system architecture.



Days 31–60: Build & Integrate



Develop and test initial AI agents.



Connect selected software platforms through APIs and approved integrations.



Establish databases, dashboards, permissions, logging, and escalation workflows.



Demonstrate working end-to-end automation to management.



Days 61–90: Deploy & Optimize



Launch approved workflows in a controlled production environment.



Measure performance against baseline KPIs.



Resolve reliability issues and document operating procedures.



Present results, cost savings, remaining manual tasks, and the next phase of automation.



Performance Metrics



Performance will be evaluated using measurable outcomes, including:



Number of business processes audited and documented.



Number of approved automation workflows successfully deployed.



Percentage reduction in manual work and processing time.



Accuracy and successful completion rate of automated tasks.



Reduction in recurring operational costs.



API integration reliability and system uptime.



Quality of technical documentation and employee adoption.



Ability to deliver projects on schedule and within budget.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is a builder who understands both technology and business operations. You should be comfortable sitting with an employee to understand a daily task, identifying how that task could be improved, and then developing an AI-powered system that performs it reliably.



We value practical experience and working demonstrations over theoretical knowledge alone.



How to Apply



Please submit your résumé along with answers to the following questions:



What AI agents, applications, or business automation systems have you personally built?



Have you used Claude API or Claude Agent SDK? Describe a project and your specific contribution.



Which programming languages, API integrations, databases, and automation platforms do you use?



Describe a business process you automated from beginning to end.



Provide links to GitHub repositories, portfolios, demos, or other examples of your work, where available.



If hired, how would you approach automating an entire company's operations while maintaining reliability, security, and appropriate human oversight?



Candidates may be asked to complete a practical assessment involving business process analysis, API integration, and the design or development of a working AI automation prototype.

title: Customer Support Agent - Shopify Dropshipping - Long Term - 30hrs/week
description:
Customer Support VA – Shopify Dropshipping (AI-assisted, fast-paced)



⚠️ EXCLUSIVE ROLE – NO OTHER CLIENTS ⚠️

You may NOT work for any other client, store or agency while working for us. Not during our hours and not outside them. We check this: time tracking with screenshots runs during every shift, and you sign an exclusivity agreement. If we find out you're working for someone else, you're out the same day and the current week isn't paid.



WHAT YOU GET IN RETURN

- Guaranteed minimum of 5 paid hours per day, 6 days a week. Your hours are never cut on a quiet day.

- Long-term position. We're not looking for someone for a few weeks; we want someone who stays for years.

- A reliable employer. Always paid on time, clear rules, and no surprises.

- You get our full loyalty in exchange for yours.



We run several Shopify dropshipping stores in the US and Europe. We're looking for an experienced customer support VA who is FAST AND PRECISE, learns quickly and doesn't need hand-holding.



THE JOB

Our support runs on an AI system. Every 10 minutes it reads new tickets in our helpdesk (Re:amaze), looks up the order in Shopify, checks tracking and supplier status, and writes a draft reply that follows our refund and return rules.



You don't write replies from scratch. You:

- Check each AI draft against the order, the tracking and the customer's message

- Fix anything wrong or missing, then send

- Handle 20–30 tickets per hour, without mistakes. If you need 10 minutes per ticket, this isn't for you.

- Speed without accuracy is useless to us. One wrong refund or a missed detail costs us more than a day of your pay.



OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES

- Handle refund, return, size-exchange and "where is my order" cases using our ticket handbook (there's a fixed refund ladder; you follow it, you don't make it up)

- Spot cases the AI gets wrong or can't d
 on: fix them yourself using the handbook, and only escalate to the manager when it's truly outside the rules

- Prepare evidence for PayPal and chargeback disputes (tracking, proof of delivery, conversation history)

- Flag supplier issues: lost parcels, wrong items, delays

- Work through the daily priority list in our CS dashboard so nothing stays open

- Report repeat product complaints (sizing, quality) so we can fix them at the source



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience in Shopify dropshipping customer support (not just general CS)

- Experience with a helpdesk (Re:amaze, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar)

- Excellent written English. German or Polish is a big plus.

- Fast and precise: you check every order and tracking detail before you hit send

- Comfortable working with AI tools

- Picks things up after being told once

- Stable internet and a reliable setup



HOURS & PAY

- Minimum 5 hours/day, 6 days/week, guaranteed (fixed schedule, times agreed together)

- $5/hour

- Long-term role



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip any step are ignored)

1. Start your message with the word TEAL

2. Send real proof of your work, for example:

   - Screenshots of a helpdesk dashboard showing tickets you handled (blur customer names)

   - A short Loom video (max 3 min) walking us through how you handle a ticket

   - A reference from a previous Shopify store owner

3. Tell us how many tickets per hour you handled in your last job

4. Apply our rules. Below are 3 rules from our handbook. Reply to each ticket following the rule (max 5 sentences each):



   Rule: No refund while a parcel is still moving. Give the latest tracking status and ask the customer to accept the parcel.

   Ticket: "I ordered 3 weeks ago and it's still not here. Refund me NOW or I'm opening a PayPal case." (Tracking: in transit, last scan 2 days ago in Germany.)



   Rule: Item doesn't fit → first offer a code for 80% off to reorder the right size. Explain why we don't do a free exchange: we ship from an international warehouse, and a return costs about as much as the item itself.

   Ticket: "The jacket is too small. Can I exchange it for a bigger size?"



   Rule: Tracking says delivered → no refund, no resend. Give the exact delivery date and place, and ask the customer to check with neighbours, household members, the mailbox and any courier text messages.

   Ticket: "Tracking says delivered but I never received it." (Delivered 14 Oct, 11:32, front door.)



No fluff, no copy-paste cover letters. Show us you're fast and precise and you'll hear from us.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering high-quality products and an excellent customer experience. We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager who can turn data, customer insights, and strong execution into profitable growth.



About the Role

The Marketing Manager will own Starbond’s direct-to-consumer growth engine across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion optimization, and agency performance. This role requires a strong command of unit economics—including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), CAC payback period, gross margin, and contribution margin—and the ability to convert these metrics into sound growth decisions.



You will directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO while leading the internal Marketing team, setting clear performance standards, and giving the CEO timely visibility into results, risks, and recommended actions.



Key Responsibilities



DTC Growth and Customer Acquisition

Develop and lead the DTC acquisition strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, social media, Amazon alignment, and other relevant channels.

Manage marketing for profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone—by incorporating product margin, contribution margin, retention, and customer quality into decisions.

Establish acceptable CAC thresholds by product, customer segment, campaign, and channel, and recommend when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue investment.

Align advertising, creative, landing pages, offers, product positioning, inventory availability, and operational readiness.



LTV, Retention, and Lifecycle Marketing

Maintain a clear and consistent LTV methodology using customer revenue, purchase frequency, retention, gross margin or contribution margin, and cohort data.

Analyze LTV and retention by acquisition source, product, cohort, and customer segment, and use the findings to improve channel and offer decisions.

Lead strategies that improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, average order value, cross-sell, replenishment, retention, and win-back performance.

Oversee email and lifecycle marketing quality, segmentation, deliverability, revenue contribution, and customer communication accuracy.



Paid Advertising and Conversion

Oversee paid media strategy, budget pacing, campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, attribution, and landing-page performance.

Establish clear testing, scaling, optimization, and stop-loss rules, and require decisions to be supported by sufficient data and financial context.

Review performance at the channel, campaign, audience, creative, product, and cohort levels.

Partner with the Web Developer on Shopify priorities, site performance, conversion rate optimization, tracking, and quality assurance.



Agency and Vendor Management

Directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO, including scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, communication standards, SLAs, KPIs, reporting, ownership, and escalation procedures.

Use agency scorecards and recurring performance reviews to track KPI attainment, SLA compliance, output quality, timeliness, efficiency, and business results.

Require root-cause analysis and time-bound corrective action plans for missed targets, SLA breaches, quality issues, reporting gaps, or inefficient spend.

Independently validate agency recommendations and recommend contract expansion, renegotiation, reduction, replacement, or termination when appropriate.

Ensure Starbond retains access to and ownership of advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Content, Creative, and Brand

Maintain an active content and creative pipeline supported by clear briefs, owners, deadlines, QA standards, and success metrics.

Ensure reliable content-production support is available when external resources are required.

Create a structured process for testing creative concepts, hooks, formats, messages, offers, and calls to action.

Protect product positioning and perceived value by avoiding excessive reliance on discounting and ensuring marketing claims are accurate and supportable.

Ensure approved assets are properly named, organized, and stored in company-owned systems.



Team Leadership, Process, and Reporting

Lead the internal Marketing team by setting clear responsibilities, deadlines, quality standards, KPIs, communication expectations, and individual performance targets.

Conduct regular coaching, one-on-ones, performance reviews, and accountability conversations; identify skill gaps and coordinate development or corrective action with HR.

Make timely recommendations regarding training, role clarity, workload changes, reassignment, or other performance actions when standards are not met.

Create and maintain marketing processes, approval flows, reporting definitions, campaign documentation, and quality-control systems.

Maintain a weekly marketing scorecard that distinguishes leading and lagging indicators and explains what changed, why it changed, and what action is required.

Proactively escalate material risks and present concise, financially grounded recommendations to the CEO.



What Success Looks Like



Marketing data, forecasts, campaign reports, creative briefs, and recommendations are accurate, validated, and financially grounded.

Campaigns, agency deliverables, reports, corrective actions, and launches are completed on time, with blockers escalated early.

CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, and cohort performance are consistently defined and used to guide decisions.

Marketing investment produces profitable customer growth, stronger retention, faster learning, higher-quality execution, and stronger brand protection.

The Marketing team and external agencies operate with clear ownership, measurable standards, and consistent accountability.



What We’re Looking For



Proven experience leading DTC or e-commerce marketing across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, and conversion optimization.

Strong working knowledge of CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, cohort analysis, and marketing attribution.

Experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, email marketing, SEO, AEO, Shopify, and agency partners.

Demonstrated ability to manage budgets and make channel decisions based on profitability and customer quality.

Experience leading and developing marketing team members, setting KPIs, and managing performance.

Strong analytical judgment with the ability to challenge assumptions, validate agency recommendations, and translate data into clear actions.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proactive and concise reporting style.

Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-moving environment.



Tools and Platforms

Google Workspace, ClickUp, Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Amazon advertising and marketplace reports, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or Power BI, Klaviyo or a similar lifecycle platform, spreadsheets, and agency reporting systems.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter that addresses the following:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Share an example of how you used CAC, LTV, contribution margin, retention, or cohort data to make a marketing decision.

Describe your experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to KPIs and deadlines.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, and lifecycle marketing platforms you have used.



Applications that include specific examples and measurable outcomes will receive priority consideration.

title: Remote Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for US AI Company (Owners, CEOs, COOs)

We help owners and operators put AI to work in their companies and we manage it for them. You will work directly with the founder who runs our sales calls.



We are hiring two people for a paid two week trial at full rate and keeping the ones who produce. Performance bonuses and long term work for the right person.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Make outbound calls to midsize US companies from a target list we provide

Reach owners, CEOs, COOs, and operations leaders, not gatekeepers

Introduce Manage AI in two or three sentences and generate interest

Book qualified intro calls for our founder

Follow up by phone and
 over several attempts. Executives rarely book on the first call

Confirm every booked call with the prospect the day before so they show

Log call notes and meeting details in our CRM (Pipedrive) the same day

Research companies and contacts as needed



REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken and written English

Confident, professional phone presence with senior business people

Proven experience booking meetings with C-level or owner-level decision makers in the US

Comfortable making 80 to 120 outbound calls per day

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace

Available during US business hours (Arizona / Mountain time), Monday to Friday

Organized, dependable, and self-motivated



PREFERRED



B2B cold calling or appointment setting for a services or consulting company

Experience calling into construction, manufacturing, staffing, or distribution

CRM experience (Pipedrive, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) and a dialer

Experience working directly with a founder rather than inside a large sales team



SUCCESS MEASURES



Daily outbound calling

Qualified meetings held with the right person at the right company

High show rate on the calls you book

Accurate CRM records



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word OPERATOR. Then send:



Your resume

A 1 to 2 minute voice recording introducing yourself in English

A 60 second recording of how you would open a cold call to the owner of a $50M construction company, using only the description above

A brief summary of your cold calling or appointment setting experience, including meetings booked per month and the level of contact

Your availability for US business hours
